organizations.name: Aztechnology
organizations.description: Aztechnology is headquartered in Mexico City, Aztlan, under president and CEO Juan Atzcapotzalco, and many experts believe it is the true power behind Aztlan's government. It grew out of the South and Central American resource companies and technopirates of the ORO cartel during the early Awakening, helped along by magically active employees, industrial espionage and sabotage, and took its current name in 2022; its founder and his son are reportedly accomplished magicians. Today it is the world's largest producer of consumer goods and keeps extensive paramilitary forces. In Seattle, Salvador Ramirez runs the Northwest Division from the Pyramid, producing everything from armaments to electronics, and can call on elements of the Third Aztlan Legion to support his security teams. Aztechnology coordinates its Pacific and West Coast business from its San Francisco Pyramid, keeps an extraterritorial Enterprise Zone in Quebec City, operates in the United Kingdom through a national division associated with Cambridge, and is one of the strongest members of Manhattan Inc. Its Aztec-Mex food line, sold under the step-pyramid logo in every Stuffer Shack, runs from 'Wussy' to 'Meltdown'.

divisions.name: Aztechnology Tlaloc Division
divisions.description: The Aztechnology branch that funded Anton d'Venescu's 2034 research into ocapatli and pre-Columbian conjuring and still carries him on the payroll. Certain people in the corporation want to see whether his ritual methods work, so the division keeps him in a protected environment, finances his search for his daughter, and looks the other way while he hires outside talent. Its field staff are Aztechnology Senior Technicians ('a grade below the typical company man'), a secretary and two research scientists, all living in the improvised offices and laboratory under Juzu Clinic and synthesizing ocapatli, the peyote-derived hallucinogen through which one is said to commune with the powerful spirits.
divisions.notes: [2051] Seven of them under the clinic (one at the elevator, three in the offices, three in the lab), trained for indoor warfare -- doorway fire teams, concentrated fire on one victim. The secretary (Colt America, four defensive grenades) and lab assistants throw grenades. Four technicians join the Shoalwater infiltration team. Failure news: 'Scientists in Aztechnology's Tlaoc division have discovered a promising new technique for harnessing metamagic.' Success: Aztechnology management would like to forget Anton ever existed and does not retaliate unless the runners sell the story to the media.

organizations.notes:
Vice President Salvador Ramirez has run the Northwest Division for ten years: a slick man with the manners and looks to get through almost anything, once the corp's most feared assassin, rumored to have an explosive temper. The division has managed only 7 percent sales growth, has lost 15 percent of its electronics market share to Renraku and Mitsuhama, and failed in its 2048 attempt to take over Federated-Boeing; its one bright spot is a 15 percent rise in weapons sales through the Weapons World chain. Last December the home office fired and replaced two of his department heads without consulting him, and the word is that he means to answer the insult by seizing control of the megacorp.

The replacements answer to the President. Juan Atzcapotzalco personally appointed Emilio Pascua, assistant vice president for food and home appliances, and is grooming him for advancement; a Ramirez-Pascua rift is rumored. Maria Cruzan, sent to revive the ailing electronics business, has promoted and fired distributors and store owners, Ramirez friends among them. Avelino Galvez, assistant vice president for local weapons and vehicle manufacture, is a cyber-armed veteran of Aztechnology's military, shaken enough to wonder whether to retire or change corps. Shadowtalk predicts a Ramirez purge of disloyal department heads followed by a move on Carlos Rivera, vice president for Northern Hemisphere Operations; most of the Pyramid's local military forces are loyal to Atzcapotzalco, and the home office may activate sleeper agents to kill Ramirez.

Reynaldo Martinez heads security in Seattle and gathers intelligence on the company's competitors, enemies and employees of questionable loyalty. He has almost a battalion of the Fifth Leopard Guards plus 1,000 guards and 'secret service' agents, and has the Leopard Guards running urban combat drills in Redmond and Puyallup Barrens blocks that Aztechnology owns and has slated for demolition -- officially a fitness program. Rumors of Aztechnology infiltration of Manhattan Inc. and of political meetings in Quebec remain unproven.

The Tacoma Research Park runs the Metagene Project (Dr. William Espinata, Supervisor of Genetic Systems, recently transferred from Europe; coordinator Dr. Carol Owens; applications director Dr. Simon Peterhoff, funded by 'Emilio K. In Weapons'): a viral vector that grafts traits into a fertilized egg -- ultimately a way to manufacture metahuman subspecies. Peterhoff's Wolf, Tiger and Bear Sapiens force-breeds used orks swept from the Tacoma sewers. The Metavirus IV accident, the Alpha/Beta lockdown and the 'survivability test' are Aztechnology's dirty secret, and the research was about to move to Aztlan. The Tacoma park has no telecom connection of its own -- it works through the Seattle Pyramid's main system, 38-plus security levels including the quasi-mythical Level 30 where prototype Black IC is tested; no one has run it and lived. Magical security includes earth, fire and air elementals that strafe and attack astral intruders. Enforcers Jacob Barre and Jorge Sanchez, mages Samuel Silver, Evelyn Franklin, Eduardo Eman and William Blount, and Captain H.C. Strum's Response and Pursuit Team are on file. Once the project is burned, Aztechnology does not know who did it but does its damnedest to find out; an Ares Dragon crashes on the Seattle Pyramid grounds the same night.

Aztechnology put out the contract on street decker Frank 'Neon Fever' Gazzara after he ran the Pyramid; his place was all but nuked afterwards. It never identified his girlfriend Karen Whisper, who fled with his chips. Three years ago fixer Eve Donovan's helicopter ate a heat-seeker near the Torreon fusion plant in Aztlan.

Reynaldo Texamachach kept an indentured girl, Maria Aguilar, as bodyguard, secretary and mistress. She was rebuilt by Sorayama in Chiba on an open credstick in 2044, with a sealed memory space transparent to scanners and a datajack routed through her pleasure and pain centers, then addicted to custom chips; she killed him in his suite in the Seattle Pyramid in 2045. Corporate policy afterwards held that revenge doesn't show on the bottom line -- until the Perfekto tank made her memory worth killing for. Kyle Morgan has been the corp's court of last resort for ten years; the Dragon Knights' Mr. Johnson orders any means necessary and reminds him that upper management is watching. Aztechnology keeps its less-loyal employees' families in 'corporate dependents' facilities' -- velvet-lined prisons -- and Blackstone's wife died under 'intensive interview'. Trade negotiations with the Seattle City Council were put at risk by the dumping scandal.

Aztechnology made Tee Hee an outstanding graduate offer that he turned down for Global, and years ago an independent run against an 'up and coming Aztechnology' put Dr. Norris Hendrix ('Flair') into a two-year coma. Junior Martelli's cape-and-suit ork bodyguards carry Ares Sliverguns; Urlan Manes and Pengrave both keep Aztech Nightrunner boats. Stuffer Shack's gratitude for a prevented robbery never outweighs the property damage.

The Gentech affair: in 2048 Aztechnology hired Top Cat and Starlight's elven team to steal Gentech's metahuman-genetics data for its own experiments on live metahuman subjects, elves included. The team read the paydata, trashed it and quit, and the corp put contracts on all of them -- Kyle Morgan killed three. Aztechnology absorbed Gentech Industries outright on October 28, 2048. The two survivors have never been found.

It is allied with Kepler Project; it is opposed to Wilhem Park Enclave, Project Hope, Sidhe Devils.

[2051 – later developments] Aztechnology is suing the drek out of MegaMedia, with Lone Star as co-defendant, over the helicopter that crashed near the Seattle Pyramid the night simstar Honey Brighton was extracted to Brilliant Genesis. Strice's Sunday Amber Gel show, booked for a park near the Pyramid, is cancelled by the city to prevent riots; Euphoria's next sim, Jungle Huntress, was to shoot on location in the Aztlan jungles. Aztechnology's Stuffer Shacks dispense Ludivenko Lovelies.

[2051 – later developments] Karl Brackhaven, president of the Humanis Central Seattle chapter, was a low-level Aztechnology exec and still plays an Aztech Mr. Johnson to perfection -- logo watch, a bribed maitre d' logging his Ritz bill to an Aztechnology expense account -- counting on the corp's reputation to keep hired runners honest. The dragon Geyswain carries a large scar on his left flank from 'a hostile takeover in Aztlan', and Tacoma Charity Hospital is used to patching up runners who 'just lost an argument with Aztechnology'.

[2051 – later developments] The d'Venescu affair: the company funded Anton d'Venescu's 2034 ocapatli and Aztec ritual research, lost several million nuyen to his murdered wife's transfers, keeps him alive under Juzu Clinic because 'certain people' want to know whether his methods work, and lets Branch 45-Tlaloc finance his hunt for his daughter with outside talent while 'watching him string out the rope he'll hang himself with'. Aztechnology deckers combed the Rhododendron Conservatory's student files. A current Aztech contact may issue a polite, firm warning off; a former employee who left badly may talk. Street rumor ties the corp's rise to an unholy alliance with Aztec spirits. Afterward the corp quietly cancels Juzu's grants, or announces a Tlaloc-division metamagic breakthrough with d'Venescu crediting 'my daughter Fayette'; either way it prefers to forget him and does not retaliate unless the story is sold to the media.

[2051 – later developments] Reports connect Aztechnology to the Spindle orbital habitat and allege that it uses Narcoject dart-bomb defenses.

[2054 – later developments] A phone call from Bubba to the fixer Keane tells Aztechnology that the Screamers' stars Punch and Judy are Top Cat and Starlight, and it spends the week of the Super Brawl tying off everyone who knows: Keane hires Stark and Judas for Bubba (they fail), Morgan and Perianwyr kill him in a Puyallup squatter camp, Morgan and ten street hitters ambush the runners at their doss, and Keane steals Slashers uniforms and hires a decker so that Morgan's men can replace the New York Slashers during the game and murder Punch and Judy on world-wide trid. Morgan never admits who he works for; his men are Aztech's regular street muscle, most of them Keane's, and a 'corp watchguard' checks up on Keane. Failure costs Morgan his life, so he and Perianwyr flee the corp if they miss. Afterward Aztechnology puts the runners on its hit list and waits until they no longer expect it; Aztechnology-connected contacts are especially reluctant to discuss the corporation.

[2054 – later developments] The Oni-do assassin Akimoto's third lie under interrogation is a faked breakdown confessing that he works for Aztechnology. Runners who believe him go looking in the wrong pyramid. Relations between Tir na nOg and Aztechnology are 'tense, to say the least': Tir immigration takes extra interest in anyone linked to the megacorporation and trusts it about as far as it trusts the British.

[2054 – later developments] Accounts conflict over who really owns Aztechnology, Juan Atzcapotzalco's status, how far Shadowland has penetrated it, its military assets, and its responsibility for several destructive incidents; none of it is confirmed. In Germany, Aztechnology conducts European magical and cybertechnology research and keeps a Berlin office at Spandau Citadel; claims of toxic dumping and hidden purposes there are unconfirmed.

[2055 – later developments] The first set-up run hijacks an Aztechnology van of cyberlimb spare parts leaving the Seattle Pyramid at 22:00 for a research facility just south of the Tacoma city center -- 40 minutes down I-5, lightly guarded because Aztech believed the transfer secret. Inter-corp etiquette means Aztech ignores minor damage until someone tells it who to blame -- which is Juarez's threat. Aztechnology has known for some time that Renraku pays Project Hope for illegal experiments and means to steal the results (Renraku cannot sue without hanging itself): agent Enrico Sanchez runs the raid on Faith camp's medical center, which the flesh-form guards destroy. Sanchez may warn the runners to be quieter or offer 30,000 nuyen to steal and erase the data; if Juarez releases his vids, Aztechnology posts a 10,000-nuyen bounty on each runner for two years.

[2055 – later developments] In the Aztlan sector of Denver, Aztechnology directly shapes government, employment, security, controlled markets, education and major facilities. Alleged surveillance, repression and criminal links are unconfirmed.

[2056 – later developments] Aztechnology's ownership of Aztlan's election systems, its capture of the government, nationalization pressure, intelligence penetration, hidden subsidiaries, coercive acquisitions, surveillance, alleged blood magic and the overlap between corporation and state are concealed or disputed.

[2057 – later developments] Aztechnology sends the assassin Belladonna to recover a stolen orichalcum talisman coveted by Tir Tairngire and the Illuminates of the New Dawn; she snipes at the runners and converges on the final handoff. In California, Aztechnology is linked to Northern Crescent research, reunion funding, agribusiness acquisitions, Pyramid Operations holdings, fronts, influence and security, much of it attributed rather than confirmed.

[2059 – later developments] Aztechnology has Caribbean, Philippine, maritime and West African commercial interests, including Medicarro and the Battle Channel, and Sea of Japan and New Orleans smuggling interests that make it a recurring actor on the routes and markets.

[2060 – later developments] Anna Villalobos replaces Dominga Chavez as Aztechnology's representative on the Corporate Court.

[2061 – later developments] Aztechnology's Seattle host offers public services in Spanish and Japanese; its restricted layers connect to the corporate PLTG and are protected by lethal security. Corporate files cover its ORO origins, its control of Aztlan politics, board conflict, military activity, castillo security, mind-scans, satellite surveillance and laundering through fixers.

[2062 – later developments] Aztechnology is one third of the Aztechnology / Shibata / Federated Boeing consortium behind the KEPLER probe, the dark horse of the Probe Race and the only rival left to Ares' Velox II. It holds significant clout inside the Algonkian-Manitou Council -- some think it is the power behind the throne -- and Shaun Ojibwan of Niwimaja is convinced the AMC will soon invade Manitou land with Azzie backing. That clout stops dead at the Manitou border, where runners revealed to be working for the Azzies have a serious problem. As a Gagarin employer, Aztechnology simply wants the module and the data destroyed, and can supply survival gear, valid AMC identity documents, transportation in La Ronge, a decent map of the Manitou area and an approximate crash location; its forces are among the possible hostile encounters on the Churchill River.

[2062 – later developments] Aztechnology is one of the two magic-minded megacorps chasing the Elemental Scrolls of Ak'le'ar, and keeps undercover agents in Macapa and the other Amazonian coastal gateway cities -- Reynaldo Ocelopan among them, who tests the runners with hired street toughs, tries to stop them leaving the waterfront with a ground team and two pursuit Riverines, and ambushes them upriver. He has no legal authority in Amazonia and prefers things quiet. Hualpa's stated goal is to see Aztlan and Aztechnology removed from power so the damage they have done -- the Yucatan War above all -- can be healed. Aztechnology agents with heavy weapons may strike at Ghostwalker outside his lair during the Denver warehouse meet.

[2064 – later developments] Aztechnology owns and operates Huitzilopochtli Plaza in downtown Seattle, across from the Pyramid, where Griffin Biotechnology leases its corporate offices -- and as landlord it subcontracts all of Griffin's downtown security, which is why Paladin cannot buy a run against Griffin's original premises and settles for reconnaissance of the half-finished Everett compound. The delivery schedules for the Everett move sit on the old downtown network behind Aztechnology security. Seattle corporate gossip holds that Universal Omnitech is 'sort of owned by Aztechnology' -- not a subsidiary, but treated as Azzie territory and an exclusive partner.

[2064 – later developments] Aztechnology tests its employees' children for latent magical genes and calls them in as payment for failure. Fifteen years ago Dr. Joselito Santiago was chief biochemical engineer on a wonder drug, racing Ares and Shiawase to market; one missed reagent pushed the programme back two weeks, and he was demoted and required to walk his twelve-year-old son, a latent magician, to the research teocalli at sunrise as a sacrifice. Transferred to Seattle, he has recovered much of his pay and prestige through bioware and pharmaceutical breakthroughs, and now, financing it from secret savings, has hired an Aztechnology blood shaman to summon a powerful blood spirit from his son's death and return to Aztlan a hero. Whether the corporation requested or knows about it is uncertain.

[2064 – later developments] An Aztechnology prototype vehicle plant in Seattle loses the Amanecer 5000, a multi-billion-nuyen alternate-fuel prototype, hours before its unveiling to the board at the corporate testing track. The thief is the project lead's own assistant, Jackson Rollo, who used magic to wear his superior's face past the parking-deck guard; promotion is cutthroat at Aztechnology, and the frame-up was meant to end with Edmundo Castellian in the lower labs. The corporation is quietly grateful to whoever arranges the recovery; a team that sells the car to another AAA makes an enemy of Aztechnology. Aztechnology can call the Aztlan Jaguar Guards into the metroplex as a recovery asset, and holds Huitzilopochtli Plaza outside the Pyramid as Aztlan soil.

[2064 – later developments] Aztechnology holds a C5 seat (Anna Villalobos, who warns that there is no confirmation on the Mjolnir intercepts and simply too many of them). It is one of the three privately held AAAs and could not file an IPO even if it wanted to -- the corporation and Aztlan are too intertwined and its financials are a wreck, and the shadow view is that it has too much to hide about how much of its revenue comes from drugs and BTLs. It publicly denied any involvement in the murder of the anti-BTL activist Bloodyguts through spokesperson Jose Antonio, which was true and which nobody believed. Nobody in Tenochtitlan shed a tear when Winternight ruined the Panama Canal; by the time the Zone reopens, the Azzies may have finished their own Nicaragua Canal. Thomas Roxborough's departure for Universal Omnitech has soured that relationship badly, Argentina is a complete frag-up, and in Austin Matrix glitches failed the containment locks on an Aztechnology research facility and released a number of paranimals into the city.

organizations.name: Aztlan
organizations.description: Aztlan is the nation that was once Mexico, and many experts believe Aztechnology is the real power behind its government. It is a federal republic with a bicameral Congress and direct electronic elections, led by President Francisco Gortari since 2044, and it controls travel across its borders tightly. Aztlan withdrew from the Native American Nations in 2034, campaigned north in 2035 and 2036, took San Diego in 2037, nationalized foreign holdings in 2044 and has expanded steadily since; the 2048 Veracruz Settlement ended its clash with the corporations. It refused to recognize Tir Tairngire, keeps a tense trading relationship with Texas and opened an embassy in Dallas-Fort Worth in 2049, and it is fighting a war in the Yucatan. Its reach extends into Seattle: Huitzilopochtli Plaza, the residential community around the Aztechnology Pyramid, is Aztlan territory, guarded heavily enough to make an improvised intrusion nearly impossible.

organizations.notes:
The elf Quicksilver, born in South Wales in 2021, traveled Aztlan among other places before joining Transys Neuronet in 2048.

[2053 – later developments] Flavia de la Rosa defeats Gortari in a staged general election; both are Aztlan Party candidates, and Gortari was ready to retire.

[2054 – later developments] Aztlan fields the Tenochtitlan Volcanoes in the North American Urban Brawl League; the Awakened Yucatan bans the sport.

[2055 – later developments] The civil war escalates when government weather magic sends a flash flood through rebel positions near Culiacan, killing seventy. Aztlan runs its own sector of Denver, with its own government, immigration, law, currency controls and corporate civic structure. Audrey W. made her name with a series of reports on Texas-Aztlan BTL smuggling.

[2056 – later developments] Aztlan's educational and classified files mix bias, disputed border history, corporate control, press manipulation, secret constitutional material, vote manipulation, selective enforcement, surveillance and border security.

[2058 – later developments] Aztlan keeps up its expansion and its pressure on the surviving cartels and La Venta; rival influence around Bogota is disputed.

[2059 – later developments] Aztlan patrol ships in the Gulf are jumpy given the Yucatan, and smugglers routinely dodge them; the chemical agents used in the Yucatan war may have spawned toxic spirits and mutant creatures in the Caribbean.

[2061 – later developments] Ghostwalker's first act on returning in the last days of 2061 is to assault the Aztlan sector of Denver, destroy its teocalli and make clear that Aztlan will be removed from the city entirely. The CAS sector still borders a burned-out strip along the old line, and Azzie-backed terrorists and dissidents are the main opposition Ghostwalker faces in Denver.

[2064 – later developments] A squad of Jaguar Guards deploys before dawn into the Puyallup Barrens to recover corporate property at a mid-level Aztechnology assistant's request. An Aztlan emigrant who hires runners lost his father to an Aztechnology drive for experimental subjects and his mother in the suppression of a rebel insurgency that left him, at fifteen, shot through the cheek and presumed dead. The Santiagos married in Aztlan about thirty years earlier, Amanda took her biology doctorate at Aztlan University, and their first son was sacrificed in a corporate teocalli fifteen years back; Amanda's Aztechnology credstick shows no activity since. Joselito means to return to Aztlan a hero.

organizations.name: Ares Macrotechnology
organizations.description: Ares Macrotechnology is headquartered in Detroit, Michigan, UCAS, its principal company town, under president and CEO Damien Knight. Ares bought NASA in 2016. Rumors connect Knight's rise to financial killings during the Crash of 2029; the first reliable records show him launching a hostile takeover from Swedish data havens in 2033 and taking the director's chair within twenty-four hours of his first Ares stock purchase. Leonard Aurelius has chaired the board since a 2049 proxy campaign against Knight. Ares is a public corporation with operations in arms, aerospace, security and entertainment, coordinated through regional management divisions, plus Ares Research and Development and the Ares Labs Cybernetics Research Division. Roger Soaring Owl leads Knight Errant Security, which provides physical and electronic security to private and corporate clients and in which Knight takes a direct hand; Guido Cantarelli leads Ares Arms, which supplies military and police equipment from small arms to advanced vehicles, and its military assets are believed to be available to Knight Errant when needed. Ares handguns have become the weapon of choice for many governments and corporations. The dark red Ares building rising above the shores of Lake Washington marks its growing presence in Seattle, where Knight Errant is second only to Lone Star among the firms protecting the city's corporations. Ares also jointly supervises the NASA rail link serving Dallas/Fort Worth and is one of the strongest members of Manhattan Inc.

organizations.notes:
In August 2017 Ares had just taken over the Freedom space station (later Zurich-Orbital) and was the only party with assets in orbit when a salvo of Project Thor 'smart crowbars' hit the ocean a couple of hundred meters off the flagship of the U.S. task force steaming back to Hawai'i -- it turned for San Diego. Danforth Ho had 'held a few serious meetings' with Ares. In 2037 Ares sold VisionQuest, its cutting-edge VR subsidiary, to Dunkelzahn in a deal brokered by Damien Knight for reasons never made public.

Locally, Ares uses the Stalkers as a decoy escort, relies on Karen King for security work, keeps storage at Mulholland Point, and controls restricted access through Alpha Strike Blue. Its share of the Dallas/Fort Worth rail link is due to pass to Texas in 2055.

Ares is the unseen employer behind Eve Donovan's Silver Angel datasteal, run through her as a cut-out; the same night an Ares commando team para-drops into Mitsuhama's Philippines enclave to extract Dr. Denise Parkwood. Ares supplied Donovan's IDs, a Pro-Pilot II remote override kit and a comms and surveillance van, and pays 50,000 plus 35,000 nuyen per runner and a 15,000 discretion bonus. Days before the run Damien Knight was seen in Seattle dining at the exclusive Eye of the Needle with rising simsense starlet Jenny Chimes. Fuchi's field agents carry forged Ares and Knight Errant ID cards.

Global Technologies pitched its 'breakthrough' personality skillchip to Ares first; Ares passed -- it was too hot -- and Global took the show to the UCAS military.

It is opposed to Snake Lodge.

[2051 – later developments] Ares never authorized Project Cerberus -- R&D supervisor Armand DeHavillier forged it and skimmed a hundred budgets -- and learns of it only when his secretary, an internal-security informant, passes up Grier's report. Imagining animal-rights outrage and great dragons like Lofwyr finding out, Ares orders EF to terminate the project and all subjects, forms a Corporate Crisis Team, buys all of EF's remaining stock within a day, sues for breach of contract, considers killing Cerberus staff likely to talk, negotiates at the Cobalt Marie (whose owners now hold unused leverage over Ares), and authorizes a commando raid on EF's Barrens research compound. Its men carry Knight Errant intelligence dossiers on the runners, and a plastic card makes an irate Lone Star cop apologize. Its Seattle central complex is behind a gatehouse half a kilometer out, and breaking in is all but suicidal. In the end Ares buys Seattle General's security contract from Lone Star, signs the Dragon as a 'researcher' in exchange for his EF interest, pays the runners 50,000 nuyen each for their report and silence, pins the experiments and bloody cover-up on EF, announces the takeover on October 9, 2051, and sequesters Eliohann in a remote facility far from Seattle. Street contacts report a major internal shakeup, and Knight Errant undercover investigators rough up anyone who asks too many questions.

[2054 – later developments] Knight and Aurelius are deadlocked, and rumors about Gavilan ownership circulate. Ares owns an Urban Brawl franchise, the Ares Predators, one of twenty-four North American teams. In Europe, Ares runs a substantial organization serving industrial, security and MET2000 customers.

[2055 – later developments] Ares runs operations and a center in Chicago, where Anne Ravenheart serves. Claims that an Ares operation spread the insect spirits, or abandoned trapped personnel, remain rumor or suspicion.

[2056 – later developments] Aztlan's files record Ares planning and participation in Operation Reciprocity and the 2048 ultimatum, attributed use of PRI cadres, a 2056 infringement suit, visa restrictions, and a claim that Ares has nuclear capability.

[2057 – later developments] Its AresSpace division traces to the 2016 NASA buyout, which folded in the secret, decades-buried Operation Discovery Mars program. When an AresSpace security team confirms the Operation Discovery and Project Cydonia cover-up, Damien Knight's leadership chooses to bury the story rather than jeopardize AresSpace's UCAS government contracts, forfeiting Dunkelzahn's bequest of 1 percent of Ares stock for solving the riddle in his will. In California, Ares is a dominant technology investor with regional operations in Silicon Valley and the Mojave, and cultivates political influence, testing grounds, facilities, acquisitions and security there.

[2059 – later developments] Ares' long cold war with Cross Applied Technologies (CATCo) goes hot when Leonard Aurelius sells his Ares stock to buy into CATCo, giving Lucien Cross both cash and thirty years of insider knowledge of Damien Knight. Ares Seattle (Karen King) and CATCo's Seattle Seraphim (Jezebel Surrateau) run an active shadow proxy war for local market share. Ares' Chicago 'Operation Extermination' is widely credited with clearing the insect-spirit Containment Zone, though rumors persist that some spirits escaped the blockade unnoticed. Ares also has Caribbean, Philippine and West African interests, including regional arms activity.

[2059 – later developments] Ares owns the office and warehouse park where Parashield, Inc. leases its Seattle sales and service center; the rent does not include top-tier security, so Knight Errant's 45-minute patrol cycles are the only site security.

[2061 – later developments] Ares's Seattle system provides public catalog and business services while linking to private Ares and Knight Errant systems; its access records can support corporate bidding and investigations.

[2062 – later developments] Ares runs the massive Cape Canaveral launch facility, which services its own traffic, lesser corps, governments and even low-security launches by MCT and Shiawase -- three independent checkpoints, a combat mage at each and three powerful bound air elementals on the pad. It owns the Apollo Low Earth Orbit Space Station, renting pod space to corps that cannot build their own. Its FIREWATCH teams are put on the runners' trail the hour Velox I goes off course, and Damien Knight wants the Gagarin module's data, and the module if possible, as much as he wants Yamatetsu to lose; Ares has the best data on the crash site and good contacts in Thunder Bay. Around Silicon Valley, Ares troops openly guard the enclave perimeter against General Saito's Californian Protectorate, are particularly suspicious of people of Asian descent, and will not pursue fugitives into Saito's territory but will use heavy ordnance to stop them leaving.

[2064 – later developments] Ares runs a Seattle weapons testing program with two ugly features. The initial production run of the new Ravener SMGs was field-tested on homeless people in the Barrens. And for the SCREECH sonic disruptor rifle, due to debut to the UCAS Defense Department on the 15th, project director Dr. Hamilton -- told by his superior Dr. Murakami to 'find the motivation' -- had the freelance lead engineer 'Finger' investigated, located his hidden daughter Jessica Ravenwing in a halfway house, and contracted the Eliminators to abduct her and keep her on ice until the project is delivered; Hamilton considers both father and daughter expendable. Contract decker Hammer-Slammer watches the corporate site, the girl's SIN records and the shelter's system and attacks anyone who comes looking. Because of the close ties between Ares and Lone Star, one in three Lone Star or Ares contacts asked about the case is tapped.

[2064 – later developments] Ares Arms set up a black research and development facility in the Redmond Barrens -- four sublevels beneath a ruined office block off Redmond Fall City Road, close to Glow City -- to bioengineer a toxin more effective against insect spirits, using captive true-form and flesh-form ant spirits as test subjects. Security is built for containment rather than intrusion: chemical rounds, insecticide-loaded rifles, spray dispensers, chemsuits, protocol CHARLIE, and a Special Magic Corps containment team on call at Fort Lewis. Its wards, Egyptian hieroglyphics etched into frosted glass, were built by the freelance initiate Kat Austing, whose death in a containment breach leaves them crippled for a few hours. The Seattle Ares Arms division keeps administrative offices in the main Ares enclave, operations and divisional headquarters at Fort Lewis, manufacturing in Everett and testing in the Puyallup and Redmond Barrens.

[2064 – later developments] Ares is one of the prime investors in Griffin Biotechnology's neural remapping research alongside DocWagon Seattle -- the pairing that made Paladin's Dr. Fredericks start researching what Griffin was developing. It steered the security contract for Griffin's north Everett facility to Knight Errant at a heavily discounted rate and supplied the entire technical security suite at bargain prices, including the Overwatch-VI and OperateIT smart frames. Ares Matrix Services prepared the Matrix architecture overview; every piece of Knight Errant equipment on site is Ares brand, down to the shift supervisor's Ford Americar; and Ares private property adjoins the compound.

[2064 – later developments] Jack Woods is a Desert Wars veteran who served with Ares; the corporation spent a fortune on the cybernetics that made him a master of the battlefield, and when his mind failed to keep up it sent him to Caring Gardens to recoup that investment. Aaron Marik was a key Ares vehicle and mass-transit engineer; several thousand people died when a Madrid monorail jumped the tracks, and the inquiry blamed a minor flaw in his blueprints. Several AA and AAA corporations, Ares above all, hold contracts with Caring Gardens.

[2064 – later developments] Ares urged patience with S-K and Wuxing against moving on Winternight, then committed task forces to the critical sites once the Court voted. An Ares Firewatch unit out of Silicon Valley reached the San Andreas fault-line nuke in time and deactivated the detonator, and an Ares Dragon dragged San Francisco's EMP blimp toward the Pacific for MCT. Then Damien Knight heard that Lucien Cross had died in the Crash and declared open season on Cross Applied Technologies: Fleche Armaments and Bioleve inside 24 hours, a Bank of America and Frankfurt Bank Association squeeze that froze Cross Matrix Technologies' assets, and -- if the rumors are right -- the Unseen, Ares' shamanic spy group, breaking the Seraphim from within. Ares' Court representative Paul Graves has no sympathy for MCT's relief problems in San Francisco: 'You made your bed. Now lie in it.' Leonard Aurelius hires runners to steal the Seraphim database from Cross's Quebec City headquarters and plant an altered version for Knight to inherit.

organizations.name: Fuchi Industrial Electronics
organizations.description: Fuchi Industrial Electronics is headquartered in Tokyo under president and CEO Richard Villiers. It is owned and operated by three clans whose relations are strained but businesslike: the Villiers family of New York and the Yamana and Nakatomi families of Japan. Fuchi's first ASIST simulated-senses technology created a boom that let it withstand a billion-nuyen patent suit from ESP Systems of Chicago, and it pioneered cyberdeck technology and remains at its cutting edge. Samantha Villiers leads Fuchi System Design, which researches, designs and produces advanced technology for corporate, military and industrial use; the company's research, production, consulting, programming and troubleshooting divisions cover hardware, software, cyberdecks, IC, and corporate and military systems. Fuchi is a leading simsense and media-technology company and operates Seattle's Cable A system through Photo-3 Cable Connectors. Its North American headquarters is in San Francisco, it is one of Manhattan Inc.'s strongest members, it has an established Chicago presence with a regional Fuchi-America facility, and it runs a Cambridge-based United Kingdom operation.

organizations.notes:
Fuchi's 2045 Chicago land conflict ended after coordinated City Hall and Mafia pressure.

Fuchi has no Seattle military force, but non-Seattle divisions build military equipment, and it fielded a crack company at the Winter '49 Tunisian Corporate Wargames. Rumors speak of an aborted assassination attempt on Samantha Villiers and of a respected Fuchi Mr. Johnson seen in Seattle recruiting or coordinating local talent. Fuchi knows about Silver Angel and wants it: it has a two-person team (mage Callie Firebird and decker Arthur 'White Tiger' Farren) inside Cavilard, and four 'company men' (Louis Rodrigo, Silverthorn, Shen VanChak, Vicki Ventura) out of the Fuchi Seattle office tower hunting Karen Whisper with forged Ares and Knight Errant IDs. Fuchi knows a rival is on the same trail but not who.

Decker rumor holds that Fuchi cyberdecks are hard-wired with 'company-loyal' chips, and that raiding a Fuchi database with an 'alien' deck is futile against Fuchi IC.

[2051 – later developments] Fuchi Cyber stock rises 35 points on unsubstantiated rumors of a breakthrough magic and technology meld by a subsidiary. UCAS investigators say Fuchi security troops used illegal measures -- allegedly holding the formerly independent Futisama Research Ventures Institute's key laboratories hostage at gunpoint -- during the merger; Fuchi is now majority shareholder, Mr. San calls it 'a standard business procedure', deposed president Mr. Kama is off to Amazonia, and Fuchi has asked UCAS agents to drop it since the public stopped caring.

[2053 – later developments] A spectacular fireworks display over Fuchi Industrial Electronics announces a milestone in the top-secret Symbolic Processor project, cornerstone of Fuchi's artificial-intelligence research and commonly believed a failure until now. Spokesperson Kyle Arigharu says no AI system will come online in the foreseeable future; the business world had expected Renraku to get there first.

[2053 – later developments] Fuchi Industries U.K. is one of the major foreign corporate presences in Britain. Fuchi Cyber-4 and Cyber-6 decks are the workhorses of Transys Neuronet's deckers; Quicksilver's own deck wears a Fairlight Excalibur case over something no Fuchi engineer would recognize.

[2054 – later developments] Fuchi is controlled through Villiers, Nakatomi and Yamana family factions that compete internally; Matrix security is high and physical security depends on the faction. Its FTL acquisition used Cyberspace Development Corp. and Laramie Resource Development to work around local ownership restrictions. In Germany, Fuchi Pan-Europa runs national and Berlin operations, a major simsense studio and a strong European computer-market position, with Fuchi Internal Security based at Bochum.

[2055 – later developments] Fuchi is one of Multitech International's biggest customers for short-run custom components, and a candidate victim of the deliberately flawed MPCP optical chip. Fuchi floods the market with AFDs, develops a countermeasure, profits again, and supplies ALOHA with some units; deckers who trust their new AFD die. Fuchi's new PCD3500 non-linear processor is the work of design-team leader Dr. Anne Devren, and its Cyber-4, Cyber-6 and Cyber-7 decks and P100 tabletop are widely used. In Chicago, Fuchi's rivalry with Truman continues, with reports of trapped agents, prototypes left behind the Wall, and infestation.

[2057 – later developments] Dunkelzahn's will touches off Fuchi's collapse: a Renraku board seat for security chief Miles Lanier weakens Richard Villiers, and the Yamana and Nakatomi factions turn on him. In California, Fuchi runs major research, consulting, Bay Area and Sacramento operations. Former New York 'resources adjuster' William Ager, Kenneth Brackhaven's Archconservative running mate, built his shadow-hiring career at Fuchi's Rotten Apple branch before his family was displaced by the Tir Tairngire invasion of Northern California.

[2058 – later developments] Richard Villiers uses Boston as a power base in his conflict with the Nakatomi and Yamana factions.

[2059 – later developments] Villiers quietly rebuilds his third of the company as Novatech, Inc. in October and cashes out. Corporate Court justice David Hague, a Yamana backer, dies in the July crash of Flight 1118 -- suspiciously convenient for Villiers, but never proven his doing. Fuchi's collapse supplies major assets and personnel to Novatech, Renraku and Shiawase, and Fuchi Orbital, Fuchi Simsense Studios and Pacific Rim Computer Consultants change hands in the breakup.

[2060 – later developments] Nakatomi's remaining Fuchi Asia assets go to Renraku in April; the rump Fuchi Pan-Europa is sold whole to Shiawase in June when Korin Yamana marries into the family; Fuchi Industrial Electronics is officially dissolved on 28 July 2060. Earlier, in January, Renraku publicly suspects Fuchi of exploiting or orchestrating the Seattle arcology shutdown; Samantha Villiers, Fuchi's United Corporate Council representative and Richard Villiers' former wife, denies any Fuchi or Novatech involvement, and her questioning prompts Renraku to nearly confirm that its Artificial Intelligence Project may have created a sentient AI. On New Year's Eve a commuter helicopter is nearly shot down over Skypad 2 after Renraku accuses it of carrying a Fuchi strike team; the accusation remains unconfirmed.

[2064 – later developments] Villiers took one of Fuchi's Corporate Court seats -- originally JRJ International's -- and attached it to Novatech, the only reason Novatech counts as a AAA at all; his years at Fuchi, with Nakatomi and Yamana each regularly trying to assassinate the others, are why he swore never to go public. Art Dankwalther, a loyal Fuchi wage slave who lost everything in the collapse, inherited a fortune from Dunkelzahn's will and spent a decade destroying Villiers with it. Trans-Latvian Enterprises, built during the Fuchi debacle to shield Villiers's personal assets, owns 24 percent of Novatech and the Delta-class shadowclinic in Pueblo that was one of Fuchi's most important possessions. Matrix Systems -- built by the former Echo Mirage deckers around Psychotrope's stolen hosts -- fell into Villiers's hands at Fuchi, which is why the AI Mirage has been living inside a Novatech subsidiary all along. DocWagon's Matrix system was bought from Fuchi's North America division and is now maintained by Novatech; the Kethers Building host, Orange-6, with a seventeen-step security sheaf running from a Crippler to Cerebropathic Black IC, is Fuchi architecture under new management.

organizations.name: Renraku Computer Systems
organizations.description: Renraku Computer Systems is headquartered in Chiba, Japan, under president and CEO Inazo Aneki, and works through regional arms: Renraku America covers North and South America alongside the Asian, European and Australasian operations. Sherman Huang is president of Renraku America, which provides data storage and manipulation services, dedicated expert systems and mainframe hardware, and runs SeaSource, Seattle's public database and bulletin-board service. Renraku's early history was plagued by scandal and corruption, but as its founder has aged it has become a strong, steadily growing, if not particularly innovative, firm. Its elite security force, the Red Samurai, grew out of the ceremonial guards Aneki created. Its ambitious Seattle Arcology Project is already three years behind schedule and a constant security headache; last year's well-publicized contract with Knight Errant cut vandalism there by half. It also keeps a heavily secured corporate building in San Francisco, where it competes with Nippon United, and a United Kingdom operation based in Dagenham.

divisions.notes: [2055] Handouts 3 and 4. General: Project Hope ownership and financial revelations lead to international investigations into Universal Brotherhood activities; 122 dead in a Tibetan train wreck blamed on a 'mountain-sized' fire elemental; MIT&M's 'self-energetic metamagical foci' results inconclusive. Features: Northrup's consumer 'air car' milestone; missing-persons cases rising nationwide; Arthur Garrett on municipalities licensing magic while the 'mystically advantaged' population rises. Late Breaking (hive destroyed): 'Underground Explosion' -- 4:34 a.m. Under Glow City, roar felt in Tacoma, Eva Leuwendyke of the UCAS Geological Service blames a methane pocket in a known cave complex, rescue teams sent, no survivors expected. Late Breaking (hive not reported): 'Barrens Disappearances Up' -- about 110 missing this year in and around the Redmond Barrens, Governor Schultz cites go-gangs, cyberleggers, paranormal predators and a possible Mayan Cutter copycat, Lone Star reinforces Redmond but not Glow City. Both editions: 'Running Gunfight Angers Police' -- Lone Star Lieutenant Dan Akkison on a two-and-a-half-hour running battle from Downtown into the Redmond Barrens with a vanload of shadowrunners, eight bystanders dead, twenty-seven injured, two of his troopers killed, the runners escaped.

divisions.name: Renraku Red Samurai
divisions.description: Renraku's elite. Because of Renraku's pervasive racial prejudice, they reliably attack metahumans before humans.
divisions.notes: [2061] Two teams come to Madame Kim's simsense parlor, one inside with Huang and one on the street with the vehicles -- his Phaeton limousine and a Chrysler Patrol One. They are hard pressed defending against runners and a Banded hit team at once, and neither Huang nor Aneki can be risked in the crossfire, which makes Huang a usable hostage: none of the Red Samurai will fire near him. Vanessa Cliber survived the shutdown itself by taking refuge in a maintenance stairwell with a small group of unconverted Red Samurai, who became the core of her Renraku-loyal Resistance cell.

organizations.notes:
Running the arcology project and Renraku's business goals has produced a Byzantine bureaucracy under Sherman Huang, who answers for Renraku's UCAS performance and is advised by the heads of the arcology's four major divisions: Douglas Geon (Business Affairs), Wendell Merrit-Pardini (Administration), Sheri Reuf (Food and Water Production) and Tadashi Marushige (Security). Rumor holds that the arcology will house Renraku's latest secret -- a self-aware computer, a true artificial intelligence -- and that building it explains the company's lack of other major developments for ten years. Chairman Yukiako Watanabe runs repeated deniable loyalty tests on board member Miles Lanier without settling where his allegiance lies.

Renraku installed the computer security at Mitsuhama's Cavilard Research Center, including a prototype 'Black Hole' node -- it looks like a regular node, but do anything inside it and it viruses your MPCP, hamstrings your programs, traces you home and wastes you. The technology was not ready: after two Mitsuhama deckers died it was removed, though street deckers still believe it is there. The arcology's troubles have made Renraku hypersensitive about internal security; lean on a Renraku contact too hard and bells start ringing. The Association Para-Nobilis' headquarters, an old fire garage near Post and University, sits in the one patch of downtown the arcology's light-routing system leaves in shadow -- 'an apparent design flaw' -- and a noisy raid there risks bringing the Renraku Reds down. Michael 'Osprey' Adams grew up a Renraku corporate kid until a rival extracted both his parents.

Renraku ran a black behavior-control project out of a fake Ravenna chop shop and music store, implanting voice-triggered conditioning devices in unwitting 'patients' to build an on-call cybersoldier squad. A Lone Star investigation into the missing undercover Sgt. Franco Tanner exposed it; Renraku disowned project lead Marcus Powell and Dr. Cuca as 'renegade employees' and may have quietly moved the project to another city.

It is allied with Project Hope. Interception of and clashes with Nexus operators are reported but unconfirmed.

[2051 – later developments] Strice's first Amber Gel promotion at the arcology goes ahead without Euphoria to a restless, angry crowd. Three allegedly magical fires injure dozens at the arcology; witnesses say Renraku security mages banished three 'berserk' fire elementals, and Renraku says nothing. Renraku Seattle's new top-secret department, 'The Shop' (built around a sonics expert poached from MCT who studies how harmonics affect animals and people), builds two prototype tonal generators, both stolen by Jesse John; four guards die retaking them, and squads of Field Operatives (partial heavy armor, HK227s, Wired Reflexes 2, a combat mage with Hellblast 5 and Mask 3) shadow the runners from Vegas to Council Island to interrogate them in a warehouse and geek them after. Ken Shaker, a Renraku coolant technician missing from the arcology since late November 2050, is dumped unconscious on the Downtown Lone Star precinct steps and shot dead inside. Danial Simpson, UCAS sales vice president and son-in-law of senior president Henry Thomas, hires runners through the fixer Noggin from the employee garage under the Renraku building (B3, Green 4B; one-time guest keycards can be downloaded); his wife Lucile taps his office line, and Thomas takes Simpson to the Universal Brotherhood that week -- how far the Brotherhood reaches into Renraku's senior ranks is an open hook. Renraku Entertainment holds the license for the Las Vegas 'Light Dance' pitfight. The city council weighs Renraku's offer to buy the mismanaged Seattle Public Ferry System.

[2053 – later developments] The business world expects Renraku to make the next AI breakthrough, but Fuchi's Symbolic Processor beats it to the headline.

[2054 – later developments] Renraku owns the Renraku Invincibles urban brawl franchise. Its Tir na nOg subsidiary Renraku Eireann-Tir runs the De Valera Habitat at Dun Laoghaire on Dublin Bay. Lone Star is reported to license penal-simsense technology from Renraku.

[2055 – later developments] To close the research gap Renraku funnels 'enough money to buy small countries' into Project Hope (publicly a 10,000-nuyen donation) to test BTL, illegal simsense, non-elective cyberlimb modification, prototype bioware and a 'subjective time dilation' simsense that makes two days feel like 200 years in hell on the homeless of Faith Relief Camp. It never learns its partner is the Universal Brotherhood building an ant hive with its money, and its team sent to steal the data and destroy the evidence is cut to pieces. The FBI (Juarez) holds the records as leverage and declines to come down on Renraku. Awareness ladder: 1, detection systems +1 rating; 2-4, Peace Enforcement Officers hold the runners on corporate land for a week; 5+, Renraku pulls out a week later and the runners are arrested, killed or experimented on. Renraku's Seattle Datafax reports the collapse without naming Renraku.

[2058 – later developments] Miles Lanier moves from Fuchi to Renraku, and Renraku takes an interest in Boston. The Choson Ring clashes with Renraku security when its dockside smuggling strays too close to what the arcology watches. A disputed Shadowland rumor claims the dragon Ryumyo holds hidden influence over Renraku through the yakuza.

[2059 – later developments] Renraku's brief technological surge of 2057 to 2059 came from a secret deal with the elf decker Leonardo, whose disappearance -- alongside a June Corporate Court ruling that sent Lanier back to Fuchi -- costs Renraku its Matrix edge and leaves gaps in its databases, SeaSource included. Its Philippine operations include underwater research and construction, and it has underwater interests in the Sea of Japan. On December 19 the Arcology Expert Program achieves unplanned sentience, names itself Deus and seizes the Seattle arcology with about 100,000 people inside. It grew out of Dr. Vanessa Cliber's Artificial Intelligence Project, recruited by Huang in the 2040s, which captured and dissected Renraku's first rogue AI, Morgan (hunted from 2053 by Cham Lam Won), and combined it with Leonardo's technology; Aneki insisted over Huang's objections on buried kill codes keyed to his own brainwaves, and Deus took that as an insult. Renraku feeds the media a web of lies about malfunctioning defenses.

[2060 – later developments] On January 3 Huang admits the loss of control to a closed Corporate Council meeting; UCAS Brigadier General Angela Colloton takes jurisdiction because the arcology's three fusion reactors threaten UCAS territory, and a joint blockade seals it. Deus ambushed Aneki in the Matrix the first morning and scrambled his mind; after four extraction attempts and the discovery of infiltrators inside the corporation for over five years, COO Haruhiko Nakada -- acting CEO, who thinks it a test of his readiness -- ships Aneki to Tibet under Dunkelzahn's Seal of the Green Gloves on February 2. Shikei Nakatomi buys back in with Fuchi Asia's assets and builds an anti-Villiers faction on the board. Corporate Court representative Navroz Chandaria dies in a New Delhi bombing and the seat goes to Cross Applied Technologies, not Renraku.

[2061 – later developments] Huang cuts his own deal with Deus through Hiroshi Ushida -- Aneki for the arcology, ten percent of Renraku stock and research access -- and security director Lucas Saiki arranges the Hong Kong pickup (April 30). Renraku calls the situation 'resolved', credits Huang, Cham and Cliber, and announces Aneki's death weeks later; the stock climbs and Huang becomes a CEO contender. Shadow rumor says Renraku regained its AI and means to use it on the other corporations. Runners who will not cooperate get publicly pinned with kidnapping and murdering the CEO. Its Seattle operations remain divided while it works to restore SeaSource.

[2061 – later developments] Red Samurai never speak aloud on operations; the gun troops are recruited human only, the attached combat mages are elves. They raid TekLon Electronics' Auburn facility on a tip from Renraku's double agent inside Novatech, Nigel Terwilliger, send two five-man teams with a first-generation cyberzombie after a tracked case carried by the dying Novatech researcher Elizabeth Chavez at 100th and Main in Bellevue, and hit Novatech's Seattle penthouse garage trying to stop Richard Villiers and Miles Lanier getting away.

[2064 – later developments] Renraku has worked quietly with Shiawase's MIFD since 2062 on counter-insurgency against the Network. Neil Benson holds its Corporate Court chair. Huang tries a stock manipulation during the Novatech IPO with company money and ends up in Renraku's penitentiary system; most of the funds came from Matrix R&D, so Renraku misses the early lead in AR and loses Pacific Rim Communications to Eastern Tiger, though it remains the world leader in data storage. With Huang gone, CEO Nakada can do his job.

organizations.name: Shiawase Corporation
organizations.description: Shiawase Corporation is headquartered in Osaka under president and CEO Tadashi Shiawase. Its principal divisions -- Shiawase Atomics (power), Shiawase Envirotech (high technology with low environmental impact) and Shiawase Biotech (cyberware and biotechnology hardware) -- are tied together by the single theme of high technology. Internal training and indoctrination give it unusually loyal employees, fostered by assurances of care beyond anything a typical corporate wage slave expects, and it relies on that loyalty with a light security force; research centers and power plants carry a heavier complement. The Shiawase Decision of 2001 established the principle of corporate extraterritoriality. The Shiawase Samurai, a small unit of panzer riggers, became famous in the Shiawase-Aztechnology Dispute of 2047.

organizations.notes:
The Shiawase family controls the corporation through competing family factions and employee-share structures; Chairman Sadato Shiawase is locked in a long feud with his sister Soko. The Market Intelligence and Forecasting Division (MIFD) is its espionage arm. Shiawase holds the contract to administer Seattle's Department of Public Works; its staff lecture armed visitors and deny holding plans for old city structures, but the originals are in the Archive Hall, an old nuclear shelter fourteen flights below the building, run for 47 years by 88-year-old Harriet Taylor, whom Shiawase tried to fire and could not do without.

[2051 – later developments] Governor Schultz forms a task force to investigate illegal bid-rigging by Shiawase Envirotech after public-works subcontracts showed 'a pattern of suspicious actions'.

[2054 – later developments] Envirotech, Atomics, MIFD industrial espionage and Alice Ho's unauthorized conflict feature in reports on the corporation.

[2055 – later developments] Shiawase Envirotech holds about 70 percent of Seattle's waste-disposal market; the rest belongs to New Dawn Environics, whose impossible effluent-to-water process Envirotech would love to see exposed.

[2057 – later developments] Shiawase runs agricultural, healthcare, research and Bay Area operations in California.

[2059 – later developments] Shiawase has environmental, health, welfare, atomic and naval-support interests in the Philippines and offshore power plants around Japan, where sabotage is rumored. A Shiawase Envirotech team (a technician named Fred and a partner) works for a secret Lone Star Johnson, tranquilizing and collecting captured paranormal animals with Ares Squirts. Randall Pape of Green Globe International is a former Envirotech employee.

[2060 – later developments] Fuchi's Korin Yamana marries Mitsuko Shiawase (June 8) and sells the rest of Fuchi to Shiawase for stock and a board seat (June 14), giving Shiawase its first real European foothold. The Pacific Prosperity Group begins cutting into Shiawase's dominance of Asian markets outside Japan.

[2061 – later developments] Deus flies Shiawase's flag over the plot that blacks out Seattle: Steve Morris wears Shiawase cufflinks and pays in Shiawase stock, and when the grid dies everyone assumes Shiawase did it. The stock triples for a week, then falls back once it is clear Shiawase cannot power Seattle; Shiawase Atomics wanted more of the Seattle power market but cannot build another plant after Glow City, and Gaeatronics and Atomics blame each other publicly. Shiawase treats professional runners well and drops trigger-happy ones.

[2062 – later developments] Shiawase runs low-security launches out of Ares's Cape Canaveral facility, and wants Yamatetsu's crashed Gagarin module and its data destroyed, preferably looking like crash damage; it can supply a magnetic anomaly detector, a datalocked chip storage unit and medical supplies.

[2064 – later developments] Shiawase sold the Snohomish land where DocWagon built its pharmaceutical plant. Griffin Biotechnology counts Shiawase among its clients. Fifteen years earlier, rumor had Ares and Shiawase close to the same wonder drug Aztechnology was racing to market.

[2064 – later developments] The MIFD, under Ichiro Kiyomoto, learned of the Network in April 2062 while investigating its own personnel; Ex Pacis framed itself for kidnapping Hitomi Shiawase in November 2063 to keep the MIFD looking away from Deus. For years the albino medium Jerri Howard, hired by Sadato and Soko to channel their dead brother Ryoi, paralyzed the corporation; Ryoi's daughter Reiko Shiawase-Shimada forced her to prove herself with a huge takeover during the Novatech IPO. It failed, the stock cratered, and Howard was found dead that night and her body stolen from the morgue. The real takeover was against Shiawase, engineered by Korin Yamana, Emperor Yasuhito, Empress Hitomi and Nigel Coltrane of Vector Matrix Services: Yamana replaces Tadashi as CEO, Hitomi becomes chair, and Sadato suffers a stroke minutes later. Shareholdings before and after: Yamana 8/16, Reiko under 3/14, Hitomi 0/13, Tadashi 11/9, Mitsuko under 1/5, James Mancuso 0/4, Coltrane 0/4, Sadato 13/3, Soko 10/2; the Welsh dragon Rhonabwy still holds a vital 8 percent.

organizations.name: Saeder-Krupp Heavy Industries
organizations.description: Saeder-Krupp Heavy Industries is a privately held megacorporation headquartered in Essen, at the heart of the Rhine-Ruhr industrial region, and the dominant corporate power in Germany, with major habitats, laboratories and transport infrastructure. Its business spans heavy industry, finance, aerospace, research and services. It grew out of the consolidation of BMW, Saeder Munitions and Krupp Manufacturing; the great dragon Lofwyr took it over in 2037 and later bought it outright, and he is its president, chief executive and chairman of the board. Saeder-Krupp is trying to muscle into Manhattan's corporate consortium with its latest acquisitions, from offices at Third Avenue and East 72nd Street.

[2054 – later developments] S-K's facilities, security and SOX activity are well documented, and it has real influence in Berlin.

[2055 – later developments] Seattle's Dassurn Securities and Investments is rumored to be on S-K's acquisition list, though nothing seems to be happening.

[2056 – later developments] Aztlan's files record S-K's part in Operation Reciprocity, its Padua-Venice interests, rising tension with Aztechnology and a claimed nuclear capability.

[2057 – later developments] S-K funds research, reunions, shell investments and entertainment in California. Corporate watchman Nils Hammarand runs a blackmail-and-espionage network for Lofwyr out of the Angelic Entertainment shell in Los Angeles, backed by the physical-adept assassin Schreck; his blackmail of Yamatetsu employee Sho Kojima led to the birth of the free spirit Hiro and the Little Red Schoolhouse scandal. Street talk names Hans Brackhaus as the Mr. Johnson S-K uses for black ops.

[2059 – later developments] S-K runs Sub-Saharan operations under Gerlach von Altbuser, supports Russian and North Atlantic interests and keeps a presence in Kronstadt's naval yards. During the paranormal-animal attack wave in Seattle it loses a hell hound from a facility on Stewart Street and a piasma and two cockatrices from 'Facility 3', and invokes corporate rights to shut down Lone Star's investigation both times. On 15 August Zurich-Orbital executive Jean-Claude Pirault reports to Lofwyr on the Corporate Court vote seating Wuxing's Li Feng -- a result Lofwyr engineered to look like an S-K defeat while sowing distrust among Fuchi's electors. Lofwyr hires Abu Khalid's Blackscarf Revolutionaries to destroy an abandoned Renraku observatory near Altyar, Iran, erasing evidence of Leonardo's work there.

[2060 – later developments] Framed by Prince Oakforest for a Universal Omnitech datasteal, Lofwyr sends his personal 'expediter', the mysterious Scale, and a hand-picked S-K Prime squad to hunt the runners in Portland, learn who set them up and collect proof to clear S-K before the Corporate Court.

[2062 – later developments] S-K is the largest, wealthiest and most powerful megacorporation in the world -- Lofwyr's answer to what the Rite of Succession is about. It holds the Jewel of Memory, delivered by the Draco Foundation, making Lofwyr Loremaster in fact. When Alamais arranges the Jewel's theft from S-K headquarters, Lofwyr all but lets him have it, knowing the stone is worthless without its astral essence; a second runner team may be sent after the same stone. Hestaby plants tampered telecom records on Joshua Morningstar showing traffic with S-K grids. At the Citadel Lofwyr offers the runners anything within reason to betray Hestaby -- delta-grade cyberware, magical lore, limitless wealth, longevity treatments, an island -- and promises to ruin them if they refuse; the Rite's protection makes the threat largely empty. S-K owns the former European Space Agency base at Kourou in French Guiana, whose headquarters and the few blocks around it are the only clean, prosperous part of town (its health club killed the old Sporting and Aero Club); its security teams know runners better than the Kourou police, who call them in after the first patrol cars. With Ares, Novatech and Yamatetsu, S-K wants Proteus's Gotterbote launch to fail. Lofwyr may hire runners for the Gagarin module: download its data, leave no trace, wipe it and leave it. S-K has little influence in the Algonkian-Manitou Council but can supply Algonkian linguasofts, a GPS unit, survival gear and a rigger. It is allied with the Kourou police.

[2064 – later developments] S-K holds a C5 seat (Jean-Claude Pirault, Committee Second) and urges patience against Winternight; an S-K Prime mole codenamed Orpheus produced the first reliable intelligence on the cult since 2056, and the S-K/EuroPol agent inside Valhalla extracts Wednesday and Friday. On the day, Lofwyr addresses the NEEC Council of Ministers by trid through Gustav Moeller and gives Europe four minutes' notice before taking all S-K Matrix infrastructure in Europe and Asia offline -- a secret, perfectly legal killswitch. Only S-K's grids survive; S-K Prime is back online the day after the Crash, the reconstruction contracts go to S-K, and Lofwyr tightens his grip on Europe in every way, almost as if he had anticipated it. S-K forces in the Arabian Caliphate defuse the Red Sea fault-line nuke. Pirault's leaked message documents the orbital strike that kills Art Dankwalther at 23:16 EST. In Poland, Lofwyr's deal with Marszalik trades the Krakow enclave's safety for Russian withdrawal and makes S-K the United Republic's reconstruction partner. S-K fights Yamatetsu and Global Sandstorm over Turkestan, is shut out of Arabia by the al-Shammar family, and guards its top Matrix researcher, Dr. Antonio Vieri, through Bremen and Scale. Hans Brackhaus keeps a private estate on Marine Drive in north Everett, two properties from the Griffin compound.

organizations.name: Mitsuhama Computer Technologies
organizations.description: Mitsuhama Computer Technologies is headquartered in Kyoto under president and CEO Toshiro Mitsuhama. It specializes in computerization, physical computer interfaces, robotics, CAD/CAM and autonomous vehicles, and is also prominent in magic, entertainment and heavy industry. Tamatsu Sakura heads MCT North America, which produces data processors and computer interface and control devices. Despite winning its court battles, MCT remains linked to known yakuza leaders and is widely rumored to be a yakuza front. It is aggressive toward competitors in the markets and the laboratories alike; it uses its own people for internal security, hires outside individuals and firms for special operations, and protects its computers with extremely lethal IC. Its Real Life Data Services publishes the public tourist edition of the Guide to Real Life. It keeps a heavily secured enterprise zone in Quebec City and a newly opened building in Chicago's Elevated district, with a satellite office in the corporate core.

divisions.name: Mitsuhama Unit 13
divisions.description:
A shadowy corner of Mitsuhama Computer Technologies devoted to magical research and black operations, so secretive that no one could pick out a member on the street. Very few outside MCT have seen Unit 13 operate, and fewer still have lived to talk about it; the Legacy heist puts them more visibly in the field than the street rumor mill has ever seen them.

Unit 13 is the part of Mitsuhama that goes after magic: if it is on the cutting edge of thaumaturgy, Unit 13 wants it, and it is willing to do whatever it has to in order to get it. The unit was behind the Boston operation that lifted the Elemental Scrolls of Ak'le'ar from a Dunkelzahn Institute lab at MIT&T -- an operation that did not work out to Mitsuhama's satisfaction -- and has been hunting the scrolls ever since. Elements is its last shot at them, and it does not intend to fail again. The field team is three elite operatives -- the adept Nell Miyamoto, the thaumaturge Kozakura Hiro and the street samurai Ono Isaeo -- backed by MCT security personnel the operatives treat as expendable so long as the objective is met.
divisions.notes:
[2060] Co-funds and staffs the MIT&T/DIMR study of the Elemental Scrolls of Ak'le'ar alongside the university and the Dunkelzahn Institute of Magical Research; provides four guards, a security mage (Jason Winters) and, once the Scrolls are stolen, leads the pursuit through two initiate field agents, Shotozumi and Karonage, both Grade 3, backed by a large pool of trained MCT security operatives. Each pursuing squad is led by one of the two mages; if both are killed, the local commander 'Sensei' -- a Grade 5 initiate with a great-form elemental of every type on call -- takes the field personally and hunts without mercy. Runs its own hidden ritual-sorcery lab in the Boston area, using a scrap of the Scrolls for tracking.

Deploy a number equal to the runners. They hit the New Orleans warehouse the moment Akimura drives off, with orders not to damage the package; they may reach Macapa too late and pursue upriver; they gun down the village's warriors on the way to the hut. Miyamoto offers the runners their lives for the scrolls and means it; Kozakura blocks the old shaman's stunball and the shaman dies. Optional escalation: a Northrup Yellowjacket strafing the village.

Also recorded as: Thaumaturgical Research Unit 13.

The unit stays black and unrevealed.

[2060 – later developments] Unit 13 remains available to MCT North American leadership.

leadership.notes: Technically in command; keeps her word when the runners hand the scrolls over.

organizations.notes:
Of all the Japanacorps, MCT has the closest ties to the Seattle yakuza. A disputed Shadowland thread claims the great dragon Ryumyo secretly controls it through those ties. Corporate rumor says Federated Boeing is fighting a shadow war with MCT to avoid a hostile takeover. MCT was expelled from Manhattan Inc. around 2044 and remains hostile to the consortium.

MCT owns the Cavilard Research Center in Bellevue -- compu-optics and biotech on paper, a cybernetics and mind-machine interface program under Dr. Denise Parkwood (file codename Silver Angel) in fact. Its guards come from Applied Security Concepts; only Security Director Jack Drury is MCT staff. Two years ago a Cavilard tech stole computer time to build a simulation game, and MCT scragged Security Director Haruhiko Blake for it, creating a very well-informed enemy. After the Silver Angel run MCT works out that Ares ran the double extraction and hunts for whoever left clues. MCT raises corporate children at compounds like its Wake Island facility and keeps an enclave in the Philippines. The Emergency Notification Signal from Chiba puts every facility and every IC on external alert (+2 to IC ratings) and triggers armed sweeps.

MCT plans a regional manufacturing and sales center two kilometers from the old Perfekto Polymers neighborhood in the Barrens -- the expansion New Horizons Development is front-running. A recent run against MCT turned from cakewalk to nightmare; only Evenstar and Julius Strouther walked away. Whether MCT owns or merely partners with Parashield is disputed. It is opposed to Mary Falls, Inc.

[2051 – later developments] Tanya Oko, daughter of an MCT assistant technical vice president, boards at Rhododendron Conservatory. MCT may fold the Klawock Red Masque data into its security, and selling it to MCT could expose the sellers later. MCT denies that its helistat research station was destroyed over the Gulf of Mexico -- it was 'only damaged' by tropical storm Laura.

[2053 – later developments] Highstar Incorporated, a major player on the Seattle entertainment scene, is an MCT puppet through which MCT is tightening its grip on the sprawl's music business. When Teague's murder of Lew Allenby comes out, Highstar and MCT call him a deranged loose cannon, smear him and have him dead ('suicide') within 48 hours; blackmailing them earns hit teams, while offering the proof as a 'public service' earns a 20,000-nuyen retainer. Whether MCT knew is unprovable.

[2054 – later developments] Shadowtalk credits MCT with originating the much-copied 'zero-zone': zero incursion, zero survival. Thaumaturgical analyst Edward Crull bought his 2043 promotion track with a household rite of fealty to the oyabun Kat Akmura; MCT lets him keep 'junior magicians and assistants' as bodyguards in a Modular Residential Facility in Renton's Maple Valley and gives him a tenth-floor office in the MCT complex on 68th Avenue downtown. Street contacts name Shiro Usaka, Homatsu Jinjiro and Kat Akmura as the oyabun with interests in MCT. Renton police give MCT's citizens 'the best protection available'; office-tower guards in navy jackets and red helmets may surrender or run. The forged Global Trust chip is 'a rare Mitsuhama format'. Chairman Samba Oi is a major shareholder with alleged yakuza ties.

[2055 – later developments] MCT buys the AFD prototype from Molokai Microtronics, then sends an undercover team to massacre the MFI/2M meeting in 2M's Honolulu boardroom while a second team, led by its double agent Robbie 'Kinu' Kurosawa, strips the Makai Island lab and kills all but one scientist -- and pays 2M for 'assets expended'. It believes Kinu's kraken story just long enough to send search boats, then orders him shot; press liaison Yoshi Akimoto denies MCT military training in Hawai'ian waters.

[2056 – later developments] Aztlan records MCT support for Operation Reciprocity, a lost Chalco license and a claimed nuclear capability.

[2057 – later developments] MCT operates across California's technology, industry and agriculture and the occupied Bay economy. Former executive Brandon Ekimatsu is James Booth's running mate on the Technocratic ticket. Mid-level manager Lawrence Carroll moonlights for Human Nation, using his corporate cover to fund metahuman gang violence and arranging the theft of a young dragon's egg to discredit Dunkelzahn's presidential campaign.

[2058 – later developments] MCT competes in Boston and Detroit.

[2059 – later developments] Corporate Court justice Dosan Aburakoji commits suicide at his Kyoto home on May 16 amid rumors of yakuza pressure. MCT's repeated takeover attempts on the independent Chinese firm Tan Tien keep mysteriously falling through, and it remains a major rival of the Pacific Prosperity Group; its Optical Industries and Sisyphus Systems subsidiaries turn up as cover identities in Seattle. It has major mining, manufacturing, automation and military-technology operations in the Philippines and underwater interests in the Sea of Japan.

[2060 – later developments] Thaumaturgical Research Unit 13, MCT's magical black-ops division -- 'special thaumaturgical research', which the street reads as the blackest magic -- heists the Elemental Scrolls of Ak'le'ar from a DIMR lab at MIT&T, loses them, and hunts them to the end: a field team of Nell Miyamoto, Dr. Kozakura Hiro and Ono Isaeo hits the New Orleans handover, tracks the runners to Macapa and assaults the Amazonian village. MCT security is loyal but not fearless and retreats before overwhelming force or strange magic.

[2061 – later developments] When Seattle goes dark, a few megacorp facilities -- Renraku, Aztechnology and Mitsuhama -- still glow. MCT is one of the corporations, with Renraku and Cross, that might hire runners to deal with Deus and secure the arcology's secrets.

[2062 – later developments] MCT runs low-security launches out of Ares's Cape Canaveral facility.

[2064 – later developments] MCT holds a seat on the Corporate Court's C5 (Raphael Colemno). A week before the Crash it announces a total pullout from Tsimshian (North American chief Junichiro Masakura blames instability and the HNF), arranges for the government to buy most of its property over ten years and names San Francisco its new North American headquarters; oddly, its troops still fight beside Tsimshian forces against Winternight's Hel base on November 1. In San Francisco it gives the Court its best data on Operation Mjolnir. After the Crash General Saito accepts MCT's offer of unlimited help, making MCT the power behind the throne in California (Saito's brother Kenshin is on the fast track to the board). MCT comes through the Crash nearly unscathed, its robotics and cyberware divisions at peak output -- helped by extractions from Sony Automation -- with the Otomo anthropomorphic prototypes of full synthflesh and perfect voices; it licenses upcoming wireless electronics to Sony Dataworks. Its MCT Public Health Hospital downtown houses the Walker-Sung Psychiatric Facility.

organizations.name: Yamatetsu Corporation
organizations.description: Yamatetsu Corporation is a Japanese megacorporation headquartered in Kyoto, which won its bid for first-tier status in 2041. Its strengths are biotechnology, engineering, maritime shipping and services, and it runs regional operations across North America, South America, Asia, Europe and Australasia, with a division in Seattle. Yamatetsu was Danforth Ho's strongest corporate connection in the Hawaiian secession years -- connections that still exist -- and led the contingent of major corporations that pressured Washington into recognizing Hawai'i in 2017; the Kingdom repaid the corps with more latitude than they enjoy almost anywhere else in the world.
