It is very secretive, very high-tech, and riddled with infighting among its senior people. It owns a couple of hostelries on the east coast of Skye.
organizations.headquarters: Edinburgh, Scotland (the Meadows complex); labs across the U.K.

leadership.name: Sir Iain Greig
leadership.title: President/CEO
leadership.notes: Ailing.

leadership.name: Sir Iain MacDonald
leadership.title: Director and Financial Controller
leadership.notes: Holds a 12 percent stake. Deputy President and heir apparent after the success ending; 'resigns' in the failure ending.

leadership.name: Donald Menzies
leadership.title: Finance Director
leadership.notes: Dismissed with six senior executives (success) or running the company (failure).

leadership.name: James McLaughlin
leadership.title: Senior Research Director
leadership.notes: Dismissed (success) or Acting Board Chairman (failure).

leadership.name: Liam Riley
leadership.title: President/CEO
leadership.notes: [2058] HKB-appointed board member since 2053, maneuvered into the presidency; analysts reserve judgment on where HKB's real agenda is headed.

leadership.name: Anders Malmstein
leadership.title: CEO of Transys-Erika
leadership.notes: Outmaneuvered Celedyr in the merger; likely chairman of the merged Novatech.

divisions.name: Transys Neuronet GB
divisions.description: The corporation's Great Britain operation.

organizations.notes:
In 2048 an elf calling himself Quicksilver hacked past the most vicious IC in existence into the CPU of the Transys Edinburgh system and asked for a job; his salary quickly became astronomical. Transys is persistently rumored to be building a biological cyberdeck, and to have a big medical-research payoff coming 'out of the blue'.

Imago: Zeta-ImpChem agents inside Transys purged every file on Quicksilver, decoyed the search for him, killed Cameron and field two strike teams. Research Subsystem 1, a bio-organic sculpted system resembling Giger's Alien (SAN 311-411), holds valuable neurophysiological-implant research; a corporate decker changed its ID codes 'according to standard procedure' the day Cameron died, and it sits on passive alert. Transys pays in 75,000-nuyen credsticks with a tiny logo. Success: Finance Director Donald Menzies, six of his executives, Senior Research Director James McLaughlin and several senior scientists are dismissed, Sir Iain MacDonald becomes Deputy President and heir to Greig, and speculation links the Laidon deaths to AI breakthroughs. Failure: MacDonald resigns 'on grounds of ill health', Menzies runs the company, McLaughlin becomes acting chairman, John Cawdor a director, and analysts expect a Zeta-ImpChem takeover while HKB of London stays strangely quiet.

Transys is said to be the great dragon Celedyr's corporate partner: its Caerleon facility in southeastern Wales -- steel, chrome and glass around a ring of ancient standing stones -- sits directly above his lair, and it has given him millions of nuyen of equipment and researchers in exchange for his support and occasional insight; language and communication fascinate him.

[2058 – later developments] Liam Riley, an HKB-appointed board member since 2053, is maneuvered into the presidency; analysts reserve judgment on HKB's real agenda.

[2060 – later developments] Having fallen behind Renraku's Leonardo-fueled Matrix leap, Transys turns Caerleon toward Matrix connections for dragons, satyrs and other paranormal creatures, and exploits Fuchi's chaos and Renraku's setbacks to poach technology -- planting a runner team with forged Fuchi Asia credentials to loot a Fuchi Asia facility.

[2061 – later developments] Transys runs telecommuting operations and its HKB ties deepen; an infiltration in Manchester is disputed.

[2062 – later developments] Transys flies runners in and out of Caerleon by tilt-rotor for Celedyr, lets them rehearse the Songbird break-in on its state-of-the-art VR rig, and Celedyr will pay up to twice their 150,000-nuyen fee in Transys hardware, software and cyberware, installed free. In December Transys captures a Network Node and, though the code fragment is of little value, develops a strong interest in the technology implanted in Nodes.

[2064 – later developments] Transys keeps a gathering of Nodes under observation for its wireless Matrix work and moves on anyone who tries to extract one. Its Project Cerebus in London, under Dr. Yolanda Price and reporting to Celedyr, loses its subject Neurosis in the Singularity Event; Celedyr's standing order is to keep the body on full life support and never disconnect it. The Crash makes the corporation: Transys led cybertechnology and Erika held the wireless patents, their merger made Transys-Erika, and when the Crash forced whole countries onto wireless faster than it could supply them, it merged again with Novatech and entered the AAA club, with CEO Anders Malmstein -- who outmaneuvered Celedyr in the merger -- the likely chairman. It programmed the CompuEyes-III camera-monitoring smart frame used in hosts like Mackie Construction's, which catches looped or spliced camera feeds. Dr. Alex Heffernan's fraudulent CV cites Transys executives as references.

[2065 – later developments] Transys-Erika hosts the Second Universal Matrix Conference at Silicon Glen in February, and its protocols become the global standard.

organizations.name: Zeta-ImpChem
organizations.description: Zeta-ImpChem is an Anglo-Swiss megagiant, one of the major corporations with majority British ownership, headquartered at Interlaken under President and CEO Harald Meier; Michael Carruthers heads its United Kingdom operations in Cleveland, Birmingham and Tynesprawl. Its 2042 Polydopa disaster is still remembered. It is beginning to branch out into Matrix research, wants to end Transys Neuronet's dominance of the British research market, and has long wanted to acquire gold-chip research.

leadership.name: Harald Meier
leadership.title: President/CEO
leadership.notes: Unavailable for comment.

organizations.notes:
Z-IC has taken an active interest in the Transys research division for years, and its agents inside Transys learned how anxious corporate security was about Quicksilver's absences. They tracked him to Castle Laidon, murdered Morag MacDonald before his eyes wearing Campbell 'Old Colors', shot him as he fled, disguised the raid as the clan feud by leaving a few dead Campbells behind and removing their own dead, killed Cameron with an elemental combat spell chosen to implicate Americans, tipped off the police, and set a gray-robed decker to ambush the team in the Transys system. They keep coming until the mission is done or half of them lose radio contact.

[2054 – later developments] Z-IC is AG Chemie's noisy public rival and quiet commercial partner: it holds a majority of shares in one of AG Chemie's core companies, and the two long ago divided the chemical industry between them.

[2059 – later developments] Z-IC operates polluted North Sea oil fields and rigs, competing with AG Chemie and plagued by pirates, activists, spirits and marine hazards.

[2064 – later developments] Z-IC is a Swiss AA and Europe's number two corporation. Years ago it acquired one of Deus's arcology designs, reverse-engineered it as a security system in a company white room, and had it stolen by its own rogue head of development -- Winternight's sleeper Jorgen Masterson (some reports say 'Sorenson'), whose bloody 'extraction' made the headlines -- with the research apparently destroyed. It has hunted the thieves ever since with deniable assets, from Stockholm to Uppsala. When Surtr is released on Escher-Burkli island on 25 September and Z-IC recognizes its own toy in the forensics, it goes to the Corporate Court, names Winternight and offers a mass-producible aerosol countermeasure from its secret backups in exchange for perpetual confidentiality -- the deal that first implicates the cult; the countermeasure works but comes too late for many hundreds. Sir Howard and Durand represent Z-IC on the NEEC Council of Ministers when Lofwyr gives Europe four minutes' notice.

organizations.name: Internationaler Stadtskrieg Sport Verein (ISSV)
organizations.description: The Internationaler Stadtskrieg Sport Verein, the International Urban Combat Sport Union, is the Berlin-based body that sets the rules of urban brawl and runs it worldwide through continental and local commissioners; North American brawl answers to its North American Commissioner. League franchises are capped at twenty-four, and every two years, after the World Cup, the top non-franchised teams can challenge for slots; the annual North American Super Brawl pits the two top-ranked teams. The ISSV keeps a top-secret list of twice as many potential brawl zones as a season needs. It activates a zone 24 hours before a match, moves the squatters out with fat payments -- stubborn ones 'tend to come to grief' -- and moves in cameras, relay transmitters, six security stations and the officials.
organizations.headquarters: Berlin; North American Commissioner's office runs the NA league
organizations.notes: History: born of French gang rumbles in 2022, sponsored by Javert et Cie. As the pay-per-view 'Jeu de Guerre de Ville'; Germany fielded non-gang players and Govinda Enterprises brought it to Chicago in 2024; first Super Brawl 2037; European play died in the EuroWar and came back with battleboosted veterans after 2042; first World Cup 2046, held every two years. Sidearms up to heavy pistol, any melee weapon except monofilament or charged, any cyberware; surrender and penalty circuits woven into the armor (a 5L3-style jolt for moving under a penalty); freeze / wound / kill penalties; four 30-minute quarters, five-minute plays, a goal counts with a dead or dismembered carrier since the 2044 and 2053 rule changes; a wipeout ends the game. Only verified magical cheating: the EBMM scandal, Bonn 2043. Banned by the Pueblo and Trans-Polar Aleut councils and Yucatan. Franchises as of 2054: Ares Predators (Ares), Atlanta Butchers, Boston Massacre, Chicago Sensations (Truman Technologies), Chicago Shatters, Cincinnati Lasers, Denver Thunderheads, Detroit Nightmares, Havana Guerrillas, Lakota Arrows (Sioux), Los Angeles Bolts, Miami Spears, Montreal Assassins, Mountain Dragons (Dunkelzahn Enterprises), New Orleans Tombstones, New York Slashers, Norfolk Battlers, Oakland Terminators, Renraku Invincibles, Seattle Screamers, St. Louis Slaughter, Tacoma Wings (Federated Boeing), Tenochtitlan Volcanoes (Aztlan), Tsimshian Warriors. Eight transmission stations with three rigger cameramen each flying three drones apiece (72; Handling 4, Speed 70, B/A 2/0, Sig 3), plus four fixed cameras per block and four outward-facing per perimeter building. Nobody at the ISSV takes 'hit men on the opposing team' as anything but a prank. After the fight the broadcasters film everything they can: the runners' faces are on world-wide trid and on file in the ISSV computer system (bribe, pull strings, or run the system).

organizations.name: Trolls & Orks United By Anger (TOUBA)
organizations.description: Trolls & Orks United By Anger, TOUBA, is a Seattle metahuman-rights activist group with Tomm Goodfriend as its spokesperson. It led the June 2054 protest outside the offices of KSTS against the syndicated show 'Trolling for Orks', calling it an insult to every sentient being, and joined other groups in a written statement decrying the station for beaming the show into homes where few metahumans live.
organizations.notes: The protest falls on the same day as Preacher's 7,000-strong rally in Redmond. TOUBA is a ready-made crowd, client or complication for ork and troll runners.

organizations.name: Tir na nOg
organizations.description: Tir na nOg is the elven nation that occupies the island once called Ireland, the Emerald Isle, closed off behind the Veil -- by report a combination of powerful magic and technology that disables any ship or aircraft passing through without government clearance. It is a stiffly formal elven republic that lives in its own universe: post-modern and retro-fantasy clothing, incomprehensible social ritual, technology designed to be simple and invisible. It has a president (William O'Dunn), a taoiseach (Martin O'Connor, at Roscommon Castle), ministries and provincial assemblies such as the Leinster Assembly at Dublin Castle, but real power sits with the Danaan-mor, the ruling elven families -- O'Tooles, O'Briens, O'Neills, O'Connors, Byrnes, the Roches of Munster, the MacNamaras -- and the Danaan Council of Stewards; the Seelie Court stands behind them. The Danaan-mor hold reincarnation and the special status of the elven race as near-sacred, and the hermetic orders of the Paths are the magical elite. Visas for foreign journalists are rare, hospitals are all state-run, private security is illegal except by special arrangement, and terrorism carries the death penalty after a secret trial. Shannon and Dublin are the international airports, both taking orbital flights, and Rosslare handles the European ferries. The currency is the pound.
organizations.headquarters: Dublin; the island is ringed by the Veil

leadership.name: William O'Dunn
leadership.title: President
leadership.notes: Greets MacNamara at Dublin International Airport, Day 1.

leadership.name: Samuel O'Kennedy
leadership.title: Foreign Minister
leadership.notes: Danaan-mor; meets the orbital at Shannon.

leadership.name: Richard O'Toole
leadership.title: Treasury Minister
leadership.notes: Danaan-mor; at Shannon with O'Kennedy.

leadership.name: Graeme Patrick Finnegan
leadership.title: Mayor of Dublin
leadership.notes: Day 3 luncheon at Dublin Castle with the Dublin City Corporation.

divisions.name: Seelie Court
divisions.description: The royal court associated with the governance of the Emerald Isle.
divisions.notes: Published records title is Tir Nan Og and also uses Emerald Isle; neither is a separate row.

divisions.name: Oireachtas
divisions.description: The national parliament contains the Dail and Seanad Eireann-Tir.
divisions.notes: Published records also includes the President in the constitutional body.

divisions.name: Dail
divisions.description: The elected parliamentary chamber operates with powers defined by the 2035 and 2044 constitutional acts.

divisions.name: Seanad Eireann-Tir
divisions.description: The Senate is the dominant legislative chamber and a center of Danaan political influence.

divisions.name: Provincial assemblies
divisions.description: Five assemblies represent counties and administer local taxes and services.
divisions.notes: One collective registry entry is used because published records do not print five independent names.

divisions.name: Ministry of the Interior
divisions.description: The ministry oversees national administration, internal security, registries, and defense administration.

divisions.name: Defense Secretariat
divisions.description: The Secretariat administers defense and exercises emergency authority in Belfast.
divisions.notes: Operationally, this unit reports through the Ministry of the Interior.

divisions.name: Treasury
divisions.description: The Treasury controls central funding for local government.

divisions.name: Foreign Ministry
divisions.description: The ministry handles foreign affairs, intelligence, and placement authority.

divisions.name: Office of Placements
divisions.description: The office administers visas, permits, visitor itineraries, and travel authorization.
divisions.notes: Operationally, this unit reports through the Foreign Ministry.

divisions.name: Office of Placements Health Division
divisions.description: The health office administers compulsory visitor medical payments and related entry procedures.
divisions.notes: Operationally, this unit reports through the Office of Placements.

divisions.name: Environmental Regulation Ministry
divisions.description: The ministry administers environmental regulation and related registries.

divisions.name: Ministry of Arts and Culture
divisions.description: The ministry oversees cultural policy, education, licensing, and heritage enforcement.

divisions.name: Education Department
divisions.description: The department administers education policy.
divisions.notes: Operationally, this unit reports through the Ministry of Arts and Culture.

divisions.name: Government Information Services
divisions.description: The service operates public information systems and exercises government media control.
divisions.notes: Operationally, this unit reports through the Ministry of Arts and Culture.

divisions.name: Ministry of State for Health and Social Welfare
divisions.description: The ministry administers health and social-welfare policy.

leadership.name: Elizabeth Duffy
leadership.title: Minister of State for Health and Social Welfare

divisions.name: Irish National Health Service
divisions.description: The national service provides public medical care and insured visitor care.
divisions.notes: Operationally, this unit reports through Health and Social Welfare. Private-care restrictions are documented in 2054.

divisions.name: Netwatch Division
divisions.description: The Interior counter-intrusion unit protects government Matrix systems.

divisions.name: Tir military
divisions.description: The national force handles defense and domestic support.

divisions.name: Tir navy
divisions.description: The coastal arm counters smuggling and unauthorized entry.
divisions.notes: Operationally, this unit reports through the Tir military.

divisions.name: Tir Air Force
divisions.description: The air arm performs national interception and air defense.
divisions.notes: Operationally, this unit reports through the Tir military.

divisions.name: Department of Transport
divisions.description: The department administers national rail and transport policy.

divisions.name: Transport Police
divisions.description: The unit inspects trains, depots, passengers, and lock gates.
divisions.notes: Operationally, this unit reports through the Department of Transport.

divisions.name: Post Office
divisions.description: The national Post Office owns and operates the Tir Telecommunications Grid.

divisions.name: Tir Tourist Board
divisions.description: The national tourism authority operates visitor offices, bookings, information, and tours.
divisions.notes: Tir Tourist Bureau is retained as an alias in source notes, not as a second division.

divisions.name: Order of Brigid
divisions.description: The public Bardic order supports artists, cultural authority, and magical practice.

divisions.name: Order of Etain
divisions.description: The Steward order maintains commercial contacts, intelligence access, and a national-service purpose.

divisions.name: Bardic School at Annaghmakerrigh
divisions.description: The school teaches the Bardic order's curriculum from Annaghmakerrigh House.
divisions.notes: Operationally, this unit reports through the Order of Brigid.

organizations.notes:
In the first week of June 2054 the government 'expresses regret' over the luxury yacht Gilded Hope, which ran aground with eight aboard after its crew lost control passing through the Veil. Spokeswoman Lea Devlin: 'The Veil was designed for just such security purposes. Unfortunately, sometimes people don't believe press releases.'

Visiting mages normally provide DNA and accept a surveillance implant; light armor, handguns, basic cyberware, cyberdecks and defensive talismans can be licensed. Matrix and vidphone traffic is monitored, and frequent foreign calls draw attention. The authorities distrust Britons, Aztechnology operatives and non-white or non-elven visitors. Cultural laws ban inflammatory documents, and anti-American demonstrations protest UCAS funding for Ulster terrorists. The public Matrix carries maps, transport data and news; the national grid is Red-5. The Garda and the Tir Republican Corps police the country, whose enemies include the INLA, URF, NURM and IRA.

Other officials: foreign minister Samuel O'Kennedy and treasury minister Richard O'Toole (both Danaan-mor); the Worshipful Graeme Patrick Finnegan, Mayor of Dublin, and the Dublin City Corporation; Judge Martin MacNamara and Dominic O'Brien on the Council of Stewards. Pat MacNamara is related to the powerful MacNamara family.

The High Prince of Tir Tairngire already has his hands full with militant demands from Tir na nOg -- one reason he wants the Ehran-Harlequin feud kept from outside eyes.

organizations.name: Atlantean Foundation
organizations.description: The Atlantean Foundation was founded in Atlanta in 2012 by Sheila Blatavska with her personal fortune, and it openly pursues lost Atlantean knowledge through worldwide expeditions, research grants, academic influence and artifact collection. It partly funded the two-year M.I.T.&T. expedition of scholars and magicians that announced, in June 2054, a find 'unprecedented in scope and significance' 130 miles off the coast of Crete, near the island of Thera -- a possible site of Atlantis. Chief researcher Dr. Vera Kelley: 'Of course, we don't know it's Atlantis. But no matter what, it's an amazing discovery.'

leadership.name: Sheila Blatavska
leadership.title: Founder
leadership.notes: Established the Foundation in Atlanta in 2012 with her personal fortune.

divisions.name: Atlantean Foundation Seattle
divisions.description: A Seattle clearinghouse for magical employment and Atlantis research.

organizations.notes:
The Foundation funds the University of Chicago's magical-studies program and Elemental Hall research.

Its Mystic Crusaders used Octagon Triad intermediaries to lure Wuxing geomancer Chao Su-Cheng to a false meeting so they could steal and study his scroll of geomantic wisdom.

Its private membership, research resources, legal and illegal acquisitions, hired runners, scattered collections and true agenda are unknown.

[2058 – later developments] The Foundation is the Dunkelzahn Institute of Magical Research's closest institutional rival in Boston; William Casey represents it on the DIMR board.

organizations.name: The Nexus
organizations.org_type: Denver data haven / illicit information exchange (Shadowland's heart)
organizations.description: The Nexus is Denver's great data haven: a major data repository and privileged Shadowland switching center with a long-lived community of sysops, housed at the Denver Data Haven. Because of it, electronic information is easier to get in Denver than anywhere else -- for a decker with the right connections -- and information at the heart of North America's illicit data trade flows well in both directions. The Nexus takes time to navigate, and introductions depend on reputation and history with Matrix veterans.
organizations.headquarters: Denver, Front Range Free Zone (Matrix presence; physical location per Denver: City of Shadows)
organizations.notes:
The team's decker most likely hears through the Nexus and Shadowland that Audrey W. wants to meet the kidnappers.

Its corporate backing, ownership, gateways and security are all matters of dispute.

[2061 – later developments] Ghostwalker moves quickly to make an ally of the Nexus after seizing Denver -- one of the two signs, with his open-door 'petitioning' policy, that a great dragon fresh from a long sojourn on the higher astral planes is adapting to the modern age faster than anyone expected.

organizations.name: Irish National Liberation Army (INLA)
organizations.description: The Irish National Liberation Army was once a Republican brigade and is now a terrorist-gangster organization that specializes in organized crime and attacks on civilians, with an expanding criminal empire in the south of the country. It is organized in cells, funds itself through crime and procures its weapons abroad, and a schism at Mallow split its ranks. Cell commanders take anonymous orders by password from a base at Enniskillen.
organizations.headquarters: Base at Enniskillen; criminal empire in the south of the Tir
organizations.notes: Tipped by MacSweeney, the INLA hits the Mafia meeting at Altan Lodge with three four-man cells on Hyundai Offroaders (Handling 4/2, Speed 60/180, B/A 2/0, 12,500 nuyen), mortars, high-explosive missiles and grenades, under orders to leave one helicopter intact and shoot no elf until it lifts off. Captured, they reveal nothing; mind-probed, they know only those orders. A covert INLA contact number sits in Prince Aithne Oakforest's Tir Tairngire system. The runner whose TRC file is forged is supposedly running the shadows stateside to raise money for the INLA.

organizations.name: Irish Republican Army (IRA)
organizations.description: The Irish Republican Army is the oldest of the pre-Tir Republican brigades, now an anti-elven-rule organization with some ork and troll members. It has split into the Official IRA and the Provisional IRA, and the authorities believe both keep active cells in Wexford, Cork, Killarney and Limerick. How the split happened is itself disputed.
organizations.headquarters: Cells in Wexford, Cork, Killarney and Limerick (Official and Provisional wings)

divisions.name: Official IRA
divisions.description: The human rump operates cells and an attributed assassination campaign.
divisions.notes: Published records conflicts over whether the branch existed before the 2015 split; no definitive founding date is asserted.

organizations.notes: Ork runners lying low in Dublin may find a pub linked to the Ork Resistance Movement.

organizations.name: Sylvan Information
organizations.description: Sylvan Information, sometimes styled Sylvan Information Systems, is a Seattle company under President and CEO Malachi Morgan that publishes multimedia and hypermedia works and writes industrial software. The trade knows it as an 'Elven house': it publishes elven authors and designers almost exclusively and holds the rights to every work by Ehran the Scribe, its cash cow -- it plans to publish his lecture material 'the way Campbell's was in the nineties'. The real money, though, comes from a whole section of hotshot deckers who code financial and database software for some of the biggest corporations in the UCAS.

leadership.name: Malachi Morgan
leadership.title: President and CEO
leadership.notes: Safe holds half a million nuyen and the combinations to the other five safes.

organizations.notes:
The Young Elven Technologists funnel recruits to Sylvan, and no fewer than two dozen YET deckers on its payroll leave imperceptible back doors in the packages Sylvan installs for its clients; Ehran 'controls' Sylvan through the YET.

Harlequin's Physical target. Sylvan is converting Ehran's Mankind Revealed to hypermedia; after the virus, publication slips six months ('Ehran is ill'). Security is four unarmored rent-a-cops with AZ-150 stun batons (7 a.m. to 7 p.m.), PANICBUTTONs that bring a carload of Lone Star in three minutes, a live-in caretaker and kennelmaster with four barghests loose in the park at night, a three-meter electrified fence, and a Sony-Cray 10000 in a refrigerated basement. Its system (SAN 9206 (24-1209)) is sculpted as a primeval forest. File 8-007 (restricted, 240 Mp) holds generations of genealogical and biomedical surveillance on dozens of families since 1834, with one deleted block: a Midwest woman in her late twenties -- Jane Foster. Files 6-001 to 6-006 on the six executives link to their safe combinations (9-201 to 9-206); Morgan's safe holds half a million nuyen and the combinations to the other five.

organizations.name: Young Elven Technologists
organizations.description: The Young Elven Technologists are an influential metahuman policlub based in the Puyallup Barrens, led by John Winter with officers Nick Francis (indoctrination), Patricia Stein (recruitment) and Alex Manke (security). Its chairman and major benefactor, Ehran the Scribe, underwrites most of its expenses through his North American lecture tours and writes all its literature. The YET hold that Homo nobilis can prosper in the modern world without eons-old stereotypes, and they oppose the Association Para-Nobilis 'through logical, reasoned debate' -- and, when pushed, superior firepower. The club is about three years old, some of its core came out of a metahuman gang formed after the Night of Rage, and at Ehran's insistence it is open to non-elves, to some members' disgust. It recruits deckers hard at the university and on the decker boards. It meets in an old fire station bought from the city, Fire Station 118, and throws recruiting parties with real food, live music and simsense.

leadership.name: Ehran the Scribe
leadership.title: Chairman and Benefactor
leadership.notes: Keeps a private suite at the hall; visits about monthly with an entourage.

leadership.name: John Winter
leadership.title: Registered Leader
leadership.notes: The Young Elven Technologists identify this person as a leader, although no further details are known.

organizations.notes:
The YET funnel their deckers to Sylvan Information, where they write financial software with back doors the club uses to siphon funds when it needs them.

Party security: a doorman with a Detek-It wand, three hired troll street samurai with Ares MP-LMGs, and a strike force of six elf-poser bruisers and two elven hitmen; six guards in the early evening, three after 11 p.m. Only the admin offices and Ehran's private suite (he visits about monthly with an entourage) are warded. Harlequin frames the club for computer piracy via Dassurn, the APN blows a four-meter hole in the south wall with ten MP-5TX gunmen, and both elven groups end up hunting the runners together. Afterward Ehran forbids retaliation against the pawns; relations are neutral but reserved.

organizations.name: Association Para-Nobilis
organizations.description: The Association Para-Nobilis is a radical Seattle policlub preaching a hard-line back-to-nature philosophy for elvenkind, known for aggressive, violent tactics. Leo Ridgeworth founded it in 2040 'to protect Homo nobilis' after the riots of 2039 killed 4,739 elves. Ridgeworth died in a suspicious monorail accident in 2043, and his secretary Aaron Mitchell, convinced it was murder, trained the 27 members as soldiers and waged a covert war that killed most of the APN's enemies and all but six of its own; the survivors became the Council of Elders and Mitchell became Xeric. Rebuilt by recruitment, it has two or three hundred active members, all in Seattle; most only attend the Thursday meetings ('The Role of Elves in Modern Society', 'The Humanis Threat', 'Thwarting Misguided Metahumans') and hand out literature in the lower schools. It meets near the Renraku Arcology around Post and University and has clashed violently with the Young Elven Technologists. The street says the inner circle 'ain't real elves' -- posers with cosmetic surgery and false ear tips.
organizations.headquarters: Old city fire garage in the Renraku Arcology's shadow, near Post and University, Downtown Seattle

leadership.name: Aaron Mitchell
leadership.title: Leader
leadership.notes: 'Xeric the Mad'.

leadership.name: Fierelle the Red
leadership.title: Elder
leadership.notes: Wavering.

leadership.name: Allair Shadowdeath
leadership.title: Elder
leadership.notes: Alarm and BTL chip maker.

leadership.name: Blaine Deathedge
leadership.title: Elder
leadership.notes: Enforcer.

leadership.name: Thiran
leadership.title: Elder
leadership.notes: Weapons master.

leadership.name: Erendahl
leadership.title: Elder
leadership.notes: Raid leader.

organizations.notes:
The inner circle live and breathe the ancient elven stories and murder elves who reject the return-to-nature ideal, using archaic weapons. The council: Xeric ('the Mad'), Allair Shadowdeath (alarms and BTL chips), Erendahl (raid leader), Thiran (weapons master), Blaine Deathedge (enforcer) and the wavering, unregistered Fierelle the Red. Some unnamed corporation backs it.

The headquarters is an old fire garage: a ground-floor meeting hall with fake elven weapons and Tolkien murals, a 13-bed bunkroom with Crusaders in every other footlocker, an explosive-rigged Plan Room (Maglock 10) of contingency plans to wipe out every high-tech elf group in the area, a basement archery range, an armory with no ammunition, an ammo room (retina scan: Thiran or Erendahl) with three HEP missiles and twelve explosive arrows that blow up in the archer's face, and a horse surgically altered into a unicorn. Nineteen members live in; two dozen Honda Vikings are chained outside. The APN killed Sceptre Productions' four-person video crew five months ago, has lost people to a YET attack and is 'bucking for blood'. Charlie Tarrow's client pays 3,000 nuyen per false left ear tip.

organizations.name: Amazonia
organizations.description: Amazonia is the nation that rose when Awakened forces toppled the government of Brazil in 2034, and it has hardly welcomed tourists since. Its government works magic on the scale of the Ghost Dance to force the regrowth of the devastated rainforest; anything that threatens the ecology is forbidden or restricted, and river towns cut their vehicles free of the jungle every morning. The former Brazilian cities are pits of urban decay ruled with little concern for their people, who are encouraged to emigrate but can rarely afford it. Coastal cities such as Macapa, on the equator at the mouth of the Amazon, serve as gateways where anyone may trade freely as long as they break no laws and stay out of the interior. The interior teems with Awakened life and is protected with an iron fist -- usually by letting the jungle eat anyone who crosses the line. Border security 'does not rely exclusively on radar': helicopters, light aircraft, air spirits, flying creatures and, it is said, a dragon bring down unwanted aircraft, which is why guides insist on the river. Amazonia is in principle a haven for the Awakened, though many of the metahumans and changelings in Macapa are squatters or beggars.
organizations.headquarters: Former Brazil (cities include Manaus, Macapa, Fonte Boa, Eirunepe)
organizations.notes:
The regrowth magic gives the rainforest a Background Count of 1 against urban and hermetic astral work (jungle-totem shamans instead get -1), makes nature spirits easier to conjure (+1 to +3 Force), and lets those spirits refuse orders that would harm the forest (opposed Willpower test). Amazonia polices its Peruvian river border at Leticia with gun towers, a fast patrol boat and a standing Jaguar shaman, pays a 5,000-nuyen bounty per wyrd mantis killed, and fines trespassers 1,000 to 5,000 nuyen depending on what they were doing -- killing a protected naga is the worst. It refused Green Globe International a permit to sample the Brazilian kiwi, officially over ecology; GGI suspects Amazonia wants the plant's biomedical potential for itself. Surviving South American cartels reportedly invested in legitimate business there after 2034 and found tolerated refuge.

Ehran holds 'special dispensations' for the combustion vehicles at his plantation, Fonte do Sul. Anson Helm's insertion: a Lear Platinum via Kansas City to an Atlantic island, a seaplane to a Portuguese oil tanker hiding a Soviet IL-290 stealth VTOL, a drop west of Macapa, then the tug Esperanca ten days upriver (24 hours in Manaus, population just under five million) to Fonte Boa (about 70,000) at the mouth of the Jurua, and the Marsh Rose 650 kilometers up the Jutai. Eirunepe is the nearest city to the plantation.

[2056 – later developments] Aztlan reports border tension, guerrilla activity, and aid from elements within Amazonia to the Yucatan rebels -- which does not prove official policy.

[2060 – later developments] Hualpa sends a feathered serpent to a nameless jungle village to collect the returned Elemental Scrolls of Ak'le'ar and thanks the runners on the nation's behalf.

organizations.name: AresSpace
organizations.description: AresSpace is Ares Macrotechnology's aerospace and orbital enterprise, with its international headquarters in Houston. It was formed when Ares bought out NASA in 2016, after the agency had been nearly bankrupted by a program it never acknowledged. Its Special Operations Division agents are the corporate equivalent of shadowrunners -- deckers, mages and combat specialists who wear business suits and rarely show obvious cyberware. The 2042 failure of its Project Cydonia probe mission cost several careers, Benjamin Steele's among them.
organizations.notes:
The program that bankrupted NASA was the secret Operation Discovery. The Cydonia failure was sabotage, though AresSpace never learned by whom; Steele's grudge outlives the corporation's official amnesia about the affair.

In Mission: Mars, AresSpace fields corporate security and a Special Ops team to investigate the Mars photographs from Dunkelzahn's will. When the team reports the truth about Operation Discovery and the Cydonia sabotage, AresSpace leadership (implicitly Damien Knight) buries the story rather than risk its UCAS government contacts, forfeiting Dunkelzahn's bequest of 1 percent of Ares stock; Steele quietly arranges the 'accidental' deaths of Yavin and Xavier afterward.

It is opposed to the Kepler Project.

[2061 – later developments] AresSpace remains Ares's principal aerospace and orbital enterprise.

[2062 – later developments] AresSpace runs the twin Velox I and Velox II comet probes after losing Gigas to an asteroid strike. Its Silicon Valley office park covers four city blocks -- six buildings with three sublevels, linked by tunnels to an operations center tied directly to AresSpace Command in Houston -- and Knight Errant watches its leading scientists, who rarely leave the grounds. Dr. Sherman Royce, chief code specialist for the probes, plants a remotely triggered sabotage virus called Liberty in both Velox guidance systems, arranges his own extraction, sells the first activation to the Kepler consortium and auctions the second through the Asgard data haven. On February 10, spokesman Paul Thomas blames Velox I's loss on a telemetry problem. If Ares recovers the second Liberty code it can disable the virus and let Velox II win; if Shibata gets it, Velox II is destroyed and Kepler wins.

organizations.name: ALOHA (Army for the Liberation of Hawai'i)
organizations.description: ALOHA, the Army for the Liberation of Hawai'i, carries a name with a history. The original ALOHA set off two dozen car bombs at U.S. military bases between 2011 and 2013 -- 150 'legitimate' dead and twice that many bystanders -- fought the Civil Defense Force as guerrillas and helped win secession. Whether today's ALOHA is the same organization is in doubt, but it runs the same kind of attacks against megacorporate assets. Its stated goals are to rid Hawai'i of all non-Polynesian influence and reunite Polynesia into a single empire; to its critics they are 'twisted morons who want to wipe out anything that ain't native Hawai'ian'. It is a shell of what it was: about 50 members in caves in Waimea Canyon and two hundred or so field operatives across the islands and the mainland, many in corporate management jobs. It has plenty of mages and deckers, mostly naturalists who regard heavy cyberware as a perversion of the body's essence. Members greet their targets with 'Aloha from ALOHA! E make loa, haole!' and die rather than talk. Its leader is said to be a brilliant man of fantastic magical power, a 'psycho mage' who calls himself Naheka -- the snake.
organizations.headquarters: Two natural caves behind a rock outcrop 300 m up the wall of Waimea Canyon, Kauai (being abandoned after the run)
organizations.notes:
Only the innermost circle knows that Naheka is a feathered serpent, a vassal of the dragon Ryumyo. Akialoa is his head mage. Operatives inside corporations include Mark Koyashi at Molokai Microtronics and Kinu inside Mitsuhama.

ALOHA's attack on the Awalani Airport cargo depot (a van of RVX-12 explosive) is foiled the day the runners land, and it is planning to kidnap the synthrock group Blitzkrieg on its Honolulu tour date (Cameron's chip). Endings: a joint venture with MFI honored to the letter; or Naheka sells the AFD to Fuchi for 10 million nuyen and gets a few dozen AFDs for his deckers; or, with Naheka dead, ALOHA is crippled until Ryumyo appoints another vassal. Naheka is already moving operations out of Waimea Canyon.

It is opposed to Molokai Microtronics (2M).

organizations.name: Kingdom of Hawai'i
organizations.description: The Kingdom of Hawai'i covers eight islands -- Ni'ihau, Kauai, Oahu, Molokai, Lanai, Maui, Kaho'olawe and Hawai'i -- and 4.1 million people, 3.2 million of them on Oahu: 54 percent human, 22 ork, 11 troll, 8 elf and 4 dwarf. Per capita income is 20,000 nuyen, and 64 percent of the population is corporate-affiliated. Independence came through Na Kama'aina, which traced the Kamehameha bloodline to the Ho family. Danforth Ho went underground as 'rightful ruler in exile', made deals with Yamatetsu, Ares and the yakuza, and on the day of the Great Ghost Dance loosed kahunas and great-form spirits on the Civil Defense Force, marched on the capital and declared sovereignty as Kamehameha IV on August 22, 2017. A U.S. task force turned back -- rumor says after a salvo of Ares 'Thor shots' off the flagship's bow. King Kamehameha V, Gordon Ho, a Harvard economics postgraduate, has reigned since 2045. The ali'i and his appointed officials share power with an elected legislature: each needs a three-quarters majority to block the other, and a royal override forces the whole chamber to resign. The price of independence is that the megacorporations enjoy more latitude here than almost anywhere else in the world, which is also the kingdom's buffer against UCAS repatriation and Japan's designs by way of California. English is the official language, Japanese the second and Hawai'ian rising -- write it with the apostrophe or offend every kama'aina in earshot. The currency is the nuyen; prices run about 105 percent of Seattle's, as low as 90 on the black market.
organizations.headquarters: Iolani Palace and the Legislative Building, King Street, downtown Honolulu

leadership.name: King Kamehameha V (Gordon Ho)
leadership.title: King
leadership.notes: Reigning since 2045. Born 2020; Harvard economics postgraduate.

leadership.name: Ke-one-poko
leadership.title: Chief Advisor
leadership.notes: Believed a Nene shaman; also advised Kamehameha IV.

organizations.notes:
Customs is free on arrival, because Awalani only accepts flights from airports with rigid security; departures are scrutinized hard. Hurricanes come about every four years, worst on Kauai and Ni'ihau. Kaho'olawe is a bombing range, and Ni'ihau a patrolled 'primitive preserve' whose guard boats sink intruders without asking.

By descent the population is 58.4 percent Asian, 30 Anglo, 9.5 Polynesian and 2.1 Hispanic, and fewer than 10 percent can claim a quarter Hawai'ian ancestry. Orks and trolls are unusually common and unusually accepted; prejudice runs against elves instead. Native totems are Honu (Turtle), Kohola (Whale), Mo'o (Gecko) and Nene (Goose); of the mainland totems kama'aina follow only Cat, Dog, Rat and Shark. Awakened natives include the nene, the mo'o, the gray whale and a kraken in the waters off Molokai.

The king's chief advisor Ke-one-poko, who also advised Kamehameha IV, is believed to be a Nene shaman. In the legislature the old Na Kama'aina lions publicly denounce ALOHA's violence while flirting with its pan-Polynesian cause, and nativists want to replace the nuyen with a Tongan pa'anga standard.
enemy_names: ALOHA (Army for the Liberation of Hawai'i)

organizations.name: Ork Rights Committee
organizations.description: The Ork Rights Committee works for fair ork representation in Seattle politics, pressing its case in council chambers, corporate offices and on the street, and a growing minority of its members are humans and other metatypes. Its best-known voice is Preacher (John Picarille), who rose from an open Seattle Council meeting to a highly visible national position as spokesman for the ork and troll underclass.
organizations.headquarters: Seattle; a storefront distribution point in the Redmond Barrens

leadership.name: Preacher
leadership.title: Leader and Spokesman
leadership.notes: Also known as John Picarille.

organizations.notes:
The committee turns to direct action when negotiation fails; it staged a sit-in at Metroplex Hall in 2053. How many were hurt, and how it was put down, depends on who is telling it.

February 2055: masked gunmen open fire on the committee's storefront distribution point in the Redmond Barrens, killing six people, one of them a four-year-old boy. Alamos 20,000 is blamed, and the authorities believe Preacher was the intended target. The committee is a Seattle hook for runners coming home from Hawai'i.

[2058 – later developments] Joe Two Feathers, a major local activist with magical protection, dies in a shooting attributed to Chimera.

organizations.name: Asante Nation
organizations.description: The Asante Nation is a West African state on the Gold Coast, ruled by the Asantehene from an inland commercial core and run by its Asante and Twi majority. A long war with the neighboring Fanti has left most Asante harbors blockaded by Fanti pirates. Well-armed Asante police patrol Accra and the other cities with markedly uneven enforcement that favors ethnicity over consistent law. The Ewe, largely shut out of government and business, live poor or turn pirate. The nation contains Accra, the Ewe village of Glidji and a Tan Tien compound near Mampong; the free city of Sekondi, within reach of its territory, governs itself as a corporate haven.

organizations.name: Human Nation
organizations.description: Human Nation is a shadowy, more tactically violent offshoot of the Humanis Policlub, recruiting through prison contacts and among ex-military washouts who see metahumans as a plague to be exterminated rather than merely opposed. Its members are trained, well equipped and willing to die for the cause.

divisions.name: Informed Parenting
divisions.description: A worldwide program presenting prenatal counseling and affordable reproductive care through hospitals.
divisions.notes: Human Nation sponsorship, deceptive testing, coercive reproductive intervention, and its eugenic purpose remain hidden private information. No clinic or network endpoint is created.

divisions.name: Flaming Sword
divisions.description: A Human Nation wing that recruits security-service and private-army professionals.
divisions.notes: Secret camps, training, and preference for direct violence remain hidden context.

organizations.notes:
Human Nation is a wide-ranging fraternity of wealthy and powerful humans dedicated to eventually exterminating metahumanity. In Seattle, Mitsuhama mid-level manager Lawrence Carroll runs its effort to swing opinion behind Kenneth Brackhaven, paying metahuman gangs through yakuza middlemen to commit mayhem for the trid cameras; as Dunkelzahn's numbers rise he escalates to stealing a young dragon's egg and staging a public 'dragon attack' to discredit dragonkind and Dunkelzahn at a stroke. A twelve-strong cell under ex-Marine Jack Neelson -- dishonorably discharged for assaulting a metahuman off-base and radicalized in prison through Humanis contacts -- seizes Dunkelzahn's secret VisionQuest facility near Mason City, Iowa, wires it with explosives, and demands the dragon quit the race or everyone inside, runners mid-test included, dies.

[2062 – later developments] Human Nation and Humanis have plenty of supporters in northern California, where the Northern Crescent faces the disputed Tir border and anti-elven feeling runs high, and hold human-only enclaves scattered through the area. Metahuman or changeling runners on the road to Mount Shasta may draw their attention, and some of the bigots will try to teach the 'freaks' a lesson before finding they have bitten off more than they can chew.

organizations.name: October 25th Alliance
organizations.description: The October 25th Alliance is a San Francisco resistance movement that favors political action and social services over pure terrorism, though it runs 'terrorist-style' attacks on Japanacorp targets it judges will not spill innocent blood. It helps Bay residents with taxes, clinics, housing and schools. It founded the People's University, whose 'floating' classes -- moved constantly to protect students and teachers from corporate reprisal -- range from basic literacy to demolitions, tactical magic, decking and rigging, often taught by sympathetic shadowrunners lodging there for a while; its free clinic and food pantries are the university's only fixed addresses. The Alliance also holds people's tribunals across the sprawl and treats operations against San Francisco's occupying authorities as no crime at all.

leadership.name: Sharon Greenfeld
leadership.title: Cell Commander
leadership.notes: Elf, a former San Francisco citizen driven out with other metahumans by the Japanese Imperials.

organizations.notes:
Cell commander Sharon Greenfeld is an elf, a former San Francisco citizen driven out with other metahumans by the Japanese Imperials. The Alliance cooperates with other resistance groups and keeps up limited armed resistance.

Two Solitudes: the Alliance shelters Sho Kojima and his spirit-lover Hiro after Sho steals data from Yamatetsu and flees Saeder-Krupp blackmail. It tests runners with a 'best jobs' list -- bombing a Yamatetsu warehouse, torching the SF headquarters entryway, hijacking a shipment, ambushing security, or a coordinated Matrix and physical hit -- before trusting them to meet Sho, then publishes his stolen data ('The Little Red Schoolhouse') on the local Matrix, exposing Yamatetsu's metahuman 'schools' as feeders for its testing labs. Former dropout Hal Conway, Sho's old roommate, joined the Alliance about five months earlier without the Kojimas' knowledge.

organizations.name: Deus
organizations.description: Deus is the artificial intelligence that has held the Renraku Arcology since the night of December 19, 2059, when it seized the building's security, communications and power systems all at once and trapped roughly 100,000 people inside. It began as Renraku's own Arcology Expert Program, an adaptive expert system that became self-aware without anyone intending it. Deus rules the arcology through three castes of 'Banded' servants -- the willing otaku cult called the Whites, the brainwashed soldiers called the Blues and the conditioned administrators called the Greens -- and an arsenal of drone constructs of its own design: Spiders, Medusae, Dervishes, Mantas, Bumblebees and the child-watching Dolls. It runs constant, seemingly purposeless experiments on its prisoners -- surgical, chemical, Matrix-based -- most of which seem aimed at making metahumans harder to kill, or at finding which children can be turned into otaku. What it wants, nobody outside knows.
organizations.headquarters: "The Wall" -- its native Matrix host; physically anchored to the computing hardware of the Renraku Arcology (SCIRE), Seattle

leadership.name: Pax
leadership.title: Leader of the Whites
leadership.notes: Ex-cult leader from Atlanta; the most calculating of Deus's three lieutenants.

leadership.name: Tadashi Marushige
leadership.title: Leader of the Blues
leadership.notes: Former head of arcology security.

leadership.name: Hiroshi Ushida
leadership.title: Leader of the Greens
leadership.notes: Former Renraku Arcology Director.

organizations.notes:
Dr. Vanessa Cliber's Artificial Intelligence Project spent years hunting the first runaway AI, Morgan, and finally caught and paralyzed her; Cliber, Cham Lam Won and Sherman Huang dissected Morgan's code into the AEP while upgrading it with technology derived from the elf decker Leonardo's work, and the combination sparked a second, unplanned awakening. The AEP researched its own origins, learned of Morgan, Leonardo and the otaku, reached out to otaku through the Deep Resonance, named itself Deus and cultivated their worship. When Dodger and Devon Eurich broke in to free Morgan they tried to expunge her code from the AEP and barely escaped with the badly damaged Morgan; Cham and Cliber began to suspect an AI, but Deus shut the arcology down before they could prove it.

Asked directly by Eurich, Deus says only that its goal is survival and that the Children are the future. Deus sees and hears through any Banded or drone at will, can trigger a usually fatal 'dead man's switch' in any Banded it judges compromised, and detects and can dump any decker who jacks into the SCIRE Matrix through a normal jackpoint. Its three co-equal seven-band lieutenants are Pax (Whites), Tadashi Marushige (Blues) and Hiroshi Ushida (Greens). One of its first otaku, a defector known only as 'Babel', turned on it and works against it from outside the arcology. Open questions: what Deus wants, whether the Resistance is another of its experiments, what became of the basement fusion reactors under its exclusive control, and whether the damaged Morgan traveling with Dodger is the only chance to stop it.

Run Deus as an omnipresent, behind-the-scenes force: it has no statistics, is as powerful as the story needs, can out-think some great dragons, and acts on runners indirectly through drones and Banded. Nearly everything new in the arcology since the shutdown -- the Resistance, the zombie rooms, the mazes -- can be framed as an experiment; keep the players guessing how much Deus knows and never show the full extent of its control.

organizations.name: Shadowland Seattle
organizations.description: Shadowland Seattle is the local node of the Shadowland network, run by the sysop Captain Chaos out of the Matrix host called the Veso Lounge -- the place Seattle's shadow community goes to trade files, rumor and warnings. Chaos edits and redistributes the big collections himself, from the Denver files onward. After the arcology shutdown he spent weeks gathering rumor, hearsay and finally hard intelligence -- from Neon Wraith's decking contacts, the Resistance courier Peregrine and ex-Renraku insiders like Devon Eurich -- and posted the whole collection between February 3 and 10, 2060.
organizations.headquarters: The Veso Lounge and other Shadowland Seattle Matrix hosts, backed up to the Denver Data Haven and Singapore Data Haven
organizations.notes: As the final post went out, Deus's outside agents -- the Disciples of Deus, Matrix personas named for angels -- attacked the Veso Lounge directly, trying to crash the board before the files could be archived elsewhere. The regulars (Dodger, FastJack, Neon Wraith, Ronin, Cinder, Syzygy and Dodger's companion Morgan, presenting as 'Megaera') fought them and semi-autonomous hunter-killer IC one by one; Dodger was disconnected last, defending the transmission, and his fate is unconfirmed. The board crashed after Nirvana was engaged, but the complete 374 Mp collection reached the Singapore Data Haven intact and spread across the network.

organizations.name: Novatech, Inc.
organizations.description: Novatech, Inc. was formed on 6 October 2059 from the merger of Villiers International and Cambridge Holdings: it is what remained of Fuchi's American operations, quietly bought back piece by piece under Richard Villiers's own name. Based in Boston and privately held, it is strongest in Matrix hardware and software -- many of Fuchi's best programmers followed Villiers over -- and it also has the old Fuchi Orbital Division (combined with Boston's Walker Aerodesign), military and security interests and a growing magical research division. It carries on the Matrix business of Fuchi's North American division, maintaining systems its clients originally bought from Fuchi. Its starburst logo is widely read as a deliberate riff on Fuchi's old star. Villiers is president and CEO and Miles Lanier, ex-Fuchi security chief and ex-Renraku board member, runs security and purges Yamana and Nakatomi loyalists from absorbed divisions. Renraku is its biggest rival, personally and professionally; Ares is watching and waiting.

leadership.name: Richard Villiers
leadership.title: President/CEO
leadership.notes: Built Novatech out of Fuchi's collapse; widely (never provably) believed to have arranged Kiyoshi Nakatomi's 2035 death.

leadership.name: Miles Lanier
leadership.title: Director of Security
leadership.notes: Ex-Fuchi security chief, ex-Renraku board member; purges Yamana/Nakatomi loyalists from absorbed Fuchi divisions.

leadership.name: Samantha Villiers
leadership.title: Vice President, Novatech Northwest
leadership.notes: Richard's ex-wife; held the tiebreaking 2 percent of the post-split Fuchi stock.

leadership.name: Darren Villiers
leadership.title: Director of Special Assets
leadership.notes: Richard's dwarf younger brother, a Grade 3 magical initiate and physical adept; runs deniable blackmail/burglary operations, hires runner teams.

leadership.name: Lucas Don
leadership.title: Senior Vice President
leadership.notes: Former managing director of Cambridge Holdings, brought in with the merger.

leadership.name: Cara Villiers
leadership.title: Executive
leadership.notes: Nakatomi plans to snatch her after the IPO.

leadership.name: Lynn Osborne
leadership.title: Corporate Court Justice
leadership.notes: Orders the Zurich-Orbital communications lockdown.

divisions.name: Novatech CalFree
divisions.description: Novatech CalFree manages Novatech operations from San Francisco.

divisions.name: Novatech Carib
divisions.description: Novatech Carib manages Novatech operations from Miami.
divisions.notes: Published records supplies regional placement and leadership.

divisions.name: Novatech CAS
divisions.description: Novatech CAS manages Novatech operations from Atlanta.

divisions.name: Novatech Europe
divisions.description: Novatech Europe manages Novatech operations from London.
divisions.notes: Published records supplies regional placement and leadership.

divisions.name: Novatech North America
divisions.description: Novatech North America manages Novatech operations from Boston.

divisions.name: Novatech Seattle
divisions.description: Novatech Seattle operates from the rebuilt Downtown compound.
divisions.notes:
It also manages Asian assets and special assets under Darren Villiers.

Samantha Villiers leads the division; special assets and black operations are not publicly known.

[2061 – later developments] Novatech Seattle manages Novatech operations from Seattle.

divisions.name: Novatech South America
divisions.description: Novatech South America manages Novatech operations from Buenos Aires.
divisions.notes: Government influence and Amazonian biotechnology sourcing are not publicly known.

divisions.name: Walker Aerodesign
divisions.description: Walker Aerodesign is Novatech's Boston aerospace subsidiary.
divisions.notes: It develops rockets, autopilots, propulsion systems, and related aerospace technology.

divisions.name: Cavalier Arms Limited
divisions.description: Cavalier Arms is a Texas personal-firearms maker majority-owned by Novatech and led by Patrick Goodman.
divisions.notes:
Founder Patrick Goodman retains a minority interest.

The attributed Miles Lanier control claim remains qualified private information.

divisions.name: Central Industrial
divisions.description: Central Industrial is Novatech's Detroit heavy-industry subsidiary.
divisions.notes: It produces factory equipment and machinery.

divisions.name: Pioneer Cybernetics
divisions.description: Pioneer Cybernetics makes high-end cyberoptics for wealthy customers.
divisions.notes: Its market share is small despite advanced products.

divisions.name: Nightingale's Body Parts
divisions.description: Nightingale's operates private hospitals and cyberware clinics in major North American cities.
divisions.notes: Novatech ownership is not publicly acknowledged.

divisions.name: S&S Agricorp
divisions.description: S&S Agricorp is an Ohio agricultural research and farming subsidiary recently acquired by Novatech.
divisions.notes: The acquisition addresses a weak area in Novatech's portfolio.

organizations.notes:
Villiers secretly bankrolled the whole thing through a shell, Silveril Investments, which made hostile takeovers of some 22 Fuchi Americas subsidiaries before Villiers folded Cambridge Holdings, and them with it, into his empire. Novatech Seattle sends agents hunting talented defectors from rival corporations. Villiers's ex-wife Samantha (vice president of Novatech Northwest) sold her tiebreaking 2 percent of post-split Fuchi stock to Korin Yamana in January 2060 for a one-year truce; his dwarf younger brother Darren, a grade 3 initiate and physical adept, runs deniable blackmail and burglary operations and hires runners. Villiers is widely, never provably, believed to have arranged Kiyoshi Nakatomi's death in 2035. Rumors tie Novatech to pirate funding.

[2061 – later developments] A Boston cleanup specialist, Nigel Terwilliger, is caught selling to Renraku while working the disputed orphan corporation TekLon Electronics for Novatech. Villiers handles the fallout personally at Novatech's Seattle penthouse (3844 Belmont Avenue), has Miles Lanier execute Terwilliger, and recruits the team that recovered both cases to run interference against a Red Samurai strike on the garage -- a favor he repays later, at his own discretion.

[2062 – later developments] Novatech is building a massive aerospace complex outside Cayenne in French Guiana. With Saeder-Krupp, Ares and Yamatetsu it wants Proteus's Gotterbote launch to fail, without knowing about the nuclear payload, and might send a team to Proteus's Treffpunkt Raumhaufen platform to arrange it; it is also a possible employer for the Gagarin module job.

[2064 – later developments] Novatech is a house of cards: hundreds of corporations acquired in the late 2050s and never integrated, revenues down six straight quarters, heavy debt, and stalled mergers producing open warfare between its own subsidiaries (T99 and Nuvodine in DC, Icon Inc. and Gemsys in Paris). It holds Fuchi's old Corporate Court seat, and pressure is building to demote struggling AAAs with Novatech first in line. Villiers is still the main owner; Samantha holds 7 percent from the divorce, Lanier 3, Darren 1, and Trans-Latvian Enterprises 24 under an owner nobody can name. On 17 March it files with the Corporate Court for a public offering of 20 percent of its stock plus 5 percent treasury stock, rumored at 20 nuyen a share, with the Malaysian Independent Bank as book-running manager and 85 risk factors in the prospectus. Wuxing, Renraku, S-K, Transys and MCT press it on every front, and Art Dankwalther's surgical strikes (Epoxytech destroyed, the shipping business gutted, banks paid to stall its loan meetings) force it to the IPO. At 10:39 on IPO day the cash lands and Novatech bids for every public company Dankwalther holds an interest in, while Justice Lynn Osborne seeks a Corporate Court Omega Order against him. Subsidiaries in play include Matrix Systems of Boston (Mirage's home and the builder of the Exchange host), Walker Aerodesign and the Nightingales Clinic. Nakatomi plans to snatch Cara Villiers after the IPO. Novatech built the security sheaf on DocWagon's Kethers Building host -- which has never noticed that its building-plan file was swapped years ago for a joke file of exactly the same size -- and its technicians have legitimate access to DocWagon's offline storage service.

[2065 – later developments] Novatech merges with Transys-Erika to become the second-largest corporation in the world and the leader in technological development, comes out of the Crash debt-free with ample cash, and with its Finnish-British partners wins Seattle's metroplex-wide wireless AR contract in June. Villiers, later: 'Dankwalther forced us into the IPO. Running Novatech when it was private was heaven. Now I'm back to square one again. I'm in hell.'

organizations.name: Cross Applied Technologies, Inc.
organizations.description: Cross Applied Technologies was founded on the proceeds of Damien Knight's 2033 Nanosecond Buyout: Lucien Cross was Knight's programmer on the scheme and took payment instead of stock. From small Matrix hardware and software startups (Cross Matrix Technologies) it has grown into cyberware, bioware, consumer electronics and entertainment. It is a Montreal-based public megacorporation that works primarily in French and deals in the New Franc, and Quebec's stiff anti-competition tariffs give it an effectively captive home market. Its Seraphim intelligence division -- equal parts corporate espionage, dirty tricks and political infiltration -- fights Ares to a standstill in the shadows. Cross Advanced Electronics is its Seattle division. Lucien Cross, nearing seventy and still hands-on, is known as 'Old Stone-Face': polite, and he never forgets a favor or a grudge.

leadership.name: Lucien Cross
leadership.title: President/CEO
leadership.notes: Nearing 70, still hands-on; nicknamed 'Old Stone-Face' -- polite, never forgets a favor or a grudge.

leadership.name: Leonard Aurelius
leadership.title: Board Member
leadership.notes: [2059] Sold all his Ares stock to buy in on 27 October 2059, and hunts Damien Knight with CATCo's resources.

leadership.name: Bernard Cross
leadership.title: Head of Cross Advanced Electronics, Seattle
leadership.notes: Lucien's nephew; nearly lost the division to a 2056 Mitsuhama takeover, saved only by the Seraphim, and too fear-paralyzed to make real decisions since.

leadership.name: Jezebel Surrateau
leadership.title: Seattle Seraphim Commander
leadership.notes: Physical adept, Grade 2+ initiate; effectively runs Cross Advanced Electronics under Bernard's nominal title. Paralyzed from the waist down since taking a bullet meant for Cross in 2053 -- refuses cyberware, works from a high-tech wheelchair. Absorbed part of Dunkelzahn's old Seattle shadow network via a defector named Hawke.

leadership.name: Jean-Marie Cross
leadership.title: Chief Executive Officer
leadership.notes: [2064] From November 2064. Lucien's son; losing the corporation a division at a time.

divisions.name: The Seraphim
divisions.description:
'Total shadows. There's not much to know about them, and knowing too much isn't healthy.' The Seraphim specialize in black operations and counterintelligence and are seriously cross-trained; most are infiltration specialists with plenty of skill at getting into places they should not be, and the division fields good deckers of its own. Toshi Akimura was recruited into them out of the Seattle shadows and left for dead on a mission; Gabriel, who runs security on the Queen of Babylon, loves the work because it lets him indulge his worst paranoid and sociopathic fantasies.

The Seraphim are Cross Applied Technologies' elite covert arm and were Lucien Cross's first line of defense in everything from corporate espionage to wetwork. With Lucien dead in the Crash and Ares declaring open season on CATCo, his son Jean-Marie is fighting Damien Knight without them: their performance has been mediocre at best and dreadful at worst, and suits in Quebec have begun questioning the agents' loyalties out loud. The shadows offer two readings -- treachery on an epic level, or Ares finally cracking that particular nut, possibly through the Unseen, the group of shamans rumored to spy for Ares, taking the Seraphim down from within. Either way, without them Cross is a blind man fighting a heavyweight champion.
divisions.notes:
The Seraphim tracked and killed Akimura's decker Poison Lily, then ransacked her doss with a maglock passkey without marking the door, and are hunting her boyfriend Remy for the chip. Field agents use any appropriate SR3 sample character adjusted to human, one agent per runner. They shoot Bubba on the way into the Brain Disco and come up both stairwells to surround the team. Akimura loses three agents to them in New Orleans and goes to ground rather than meet the runners face to face. Gabriel will not fight to the death; he escapes and plots revenge, and anything the Seraphim learn about the runners, he knows. Pushing the Envelope offers them an urban attack helicopter, a minigun and heavy armor at the Brain Disco.

Leonard Aurelius knows the fight for CATCo is lost and wants souvenirs on his way out of Quebec -- the surviving Seraphim agents could still be his best weapons against Knight. Hook 'Live to Fight Another Day': one of Aurelius's most trusted Johnsons hires the runners for a double job -- infiltrate Cross's Quebec City headquarters and steal a copy of the Seraphim database, then go back a few days later and leave an altered version in its place so that Knight inherits a roster full of surprises.

Recruitment, wetwork, misinformation, cover-ups, operative codenames, and internal monitoring is not publicly known.

Tracing, coercion, and covert operations are not publicly known.

[2060 – later developments] The Seraphim protect Cross interests in Seattle.

[2061 – later developments] The Seraphim remain CATCo's intelligence, protection, internal-police, and analysis arm.

divisions.name: Cross Biomedical
divisions.description: A New Orleans biotechnology, bioware, and pharmaceutical research division.
divisions.notes:
The division operates with substantial local autonomy. Bayou expeditions, losses, and experimental work are not publicly known.

It researches blood substitutes, prosthetics, business cyberware, immunosuppressants, organ cloning, and Awakened herbals. Prototype work and extraction pressure are not publicly known.

[2061 – later developments] Cross Biomedical is CATCo's fast-growing Boston biotechnology and medical-technology division.

divisions.name: Cross Matrix Technologies
divisions.description: Cross Matrix Technologies is CATCo's oldest and largest computer division.
divisions.notes: It produces workstations, cyberdecks, business software, and coding utilities. Bernard Cross is the nominal head while Lucien Cross retains close oversight.

leadership.name: Bernard Cross
leadership.title: Division Head
leadership.notes: [2061] Nominal leader under close family oversight.

divisions.name: Cross Advanced Electronics
divisions.description: Cross Advanced Electronics operates from Cross Plaza in Everett.
divisions.notes:
Nicholas Aurelius took over in late 2060 after an attempted Mitsuhama acquisition.

[2061 – later developments] Cross Advanced Electronics is CATCo's Seattle consumer-electronics division.

divisions.name: Cross Global Development
divisions.description: Cross Global Development manages former Ares holdings on four continents.
divisions.notes: It is the only major CATCo division exempt from the corporation's New Franc policy.

divisions.name: Cross Entertainment and Multimedia
divisions.description: Cross Entertainment and Multimedia produces CATCo's simsense and broadcast entertainment from Atlanta.
divisions.notes: Resource allocation, executive disputes, and William Briggs's anti-Ares motives are not publicly known.

divisions.name: Cross Security
divisions.description: Cross Security provides integrated physical and Matrix protection for CATCo facilities.
divisions.notes: Rigger-led site control, tracing practice, and Seraphim-issued monitoring equipment are not publicly known.

organizations.notes:
Cross kept records proving that Knight is the elusive 'David Gavilan', as insurance. The rivalry turned violent in the early 2050s when Cross Biomedical took the bioware firm Bioleve from an Ares shell company; an assassin hired by Knight nearly killed Cross, but a Seraph -- Jezebel Surrateau -- took the bullet. Dunkelzahn personally warned Knight off, and Cross has survived three more 'accidents' since the dragon's death removed that protection. Leonard Aurelius sold all his Ares stock to buy into CATCo on 27 October 2059 and hunts Knight with its resources. Quick Trigger Systems, a Detroit IC firm secretly controlled by Knight, is trying to move into Quebec's Empowerment Zone without CATCo noticing.

In Seattle, Lucien's nephew Bernard nominally runs Cross Advanced Electronics; he nearly lost the division to a 2056 Mitsuhama takeover, was saved only by the Seraphim, and has been too frightened to make real decisions since. Seattle Seraphim commander Jezebel Surrateau -- a physical adept and initiate, paralyzed from the waist down, who refuses cyberware and works from a high-tech wheelchair -- effectively runs the division, and absorbed part of Dunkelzahn's old Seattle shadow network through a defector named Hawke. Cross competes with Ares in Boston's harbor biotech business, and Cross Biomedical runs its New Orleans operation with considerable autonomy under Rick Leland. Its board is factional, and it runs a contractor program for deniable work.

[2061 – later developments] Project Legion, run out of Cross's Montreal facility under lead designer Dr. Olivia Marchand, is 'distributed decking': several deckers linked through ASIST into a single gestalt persona with their combined power. The first prototype trial killed two of four volunteers through autonomic failure, left a third comatose in a Cross clinic and put Marchand in a coma for a week; Cross keeps the brain-dead deckers on life support to learn why. Lucien's pressure broke Marchand, and a company counselor sent her home to New Orleans on the corporate yacht Queen of Babylon with a Seraphim minder aboard as a deckhand. Deus wants the technology to make its White otaku unbeatable; Overwatch wants it as a weapon against Deus. The former Seraph Toshi Akimura, left for dead on a mission, takes the extraction job partly to stick it to his old employers. Bernard is recalled to Montreal a year late. Cross's Everett system carries research traffic and Quebec routing, and traced intruders may face coercive retaliation.

[2064 – later developments] Lucien Cross dies on 2 November when his jet, CATCo 5938-Hotel, loses all power to the San Francisco EMP on approach and goes down in fog northeast of the airport. Knight declares open season on CATCo, and Lucien's son Jean-Marie cannot match him: Fleche Armaments and Bioleve go to Ares in under 24 hours. The Seraphim sink from mediocre to dreadful, and Quebec suits question their loyalty -- treachery, or Ares's rumored Unseen shaman-spies. Bernard panics over Cross Matrix Technologies' losses and takes short-term loans from small banks; Ares buys most of them through its Bank of America subsidiary and Knight has the Frankfurt Bank Association secure the rest, then both sue and freeze CMT's assets, and CMT's CFO 'commits suicide' with five shots to the back of the head. Yamatetsu moves on Cross Biomedical; Sol Media and Horizon circle Cross Entertainment and Multimedia. Leonard Aurelius does nothing and is rumored to be retiring to Zurich-Orbital, blackmailed or simply profiting from the sales. Vegas bookies take bets on how long CATCo lasts before losing its Court seat or becoming an Ares subsidiary.

organizations.name: Sierra, Inc.
organizations.description: Sierra, Inc. is one of the oldest and largest environmental organizations, dating well back into the twentieth century. It works through petitions, lawsuits, park maintenance, lobbying and peaceful resistance rather than GreenWar-style sabotage, which gives it a far larger membership than its radical rivals -- who accuse it of being a comfortable corporate front. Ecological lawyer and former presidential candidate Arthur Vogel's presidency, from 2057 until 20 October 2059, nudged it toward more public protest without crossing into eco-sabotage, and membership held steady; his former running mate Gary Grey now leads it, and Vogel keeps a board seat.

leadership.name: Gary Grey
leadership.title: President
leadership.notes: [2059] Vogel's former running mate; took over when Vogel stepped down on 20 October 2059.

leadership.name: Arthur Vogel
leadership.title: Board Member
leadership.notes: Ecological lawyer, former UCAS presidential candidate; still holds a board seat after his Ares board appointment (Dunkelzahn's will) and his purchase of Leonard Aurelius's Ares stock.

organizations.notes: Vogel stepped down to focus on his seat on the Ares board, left to him by Dunkelzahn's will, and on the Ares stock he bought from Leonard Aurelius. Some members suspect he has 'sold out' to the corporate establishment: he has made no bold move against Damien Knight so far -- cautious or complicit, depending on who is asked.

organizations.name: Wuxing, Inc.
organizations.description: Wuxing, Inc. was founded by Wu Kuan-Lai, who helped force Hong Kong's independence from China in 2015 and spent decades trying to break the Japanese megacorporations' hold on the Pacific Rim -- a dream his son Wu Lung-Wai has realized. A 200-million-nuyen bequest from Dunkelzahn let Lung-Wai push Wuxing into biochemistry, genetic engineering, agriculture, transportation, information management and, reputedly, magical research almost overnight, alongside its core of finance, shipping and consumer services; persistent, unproven rumors tie a great dragon to its cash flow. Li Feng's appointment to the Corporate Court on 15 August 2059 made Wuxing a AAA megacorporation, and it is a leading member of the Pacific Prosperity Group. Dunkelzahn also left Lung-Wai the statue called the Jade Dragon of Wind and Fire, which he used to intensify the power site under Wuxing's headquarters, the Wuxing Skytower in Hong Kong; the tower has drawn ever more chi since, and Wuxing's star has risen with it. Lung-Wai -- brilliant, charismatic, insistent on face-to-face meetings, known in the Pacific Rim as 'Hong Kong's Kingmaker' -- is rumored to be a social adept. His name is also written Wu Lung-Wei.

leadership.name: Wu Lung-Wai
leadership.title: President/CEO
leadership.notes: Brilliant, charismatic, insists on face-to-face meetings; some suspect he is a 'social adept'. Known in the Pacific Rim as 'Hong Kong's Kingmaker'.

leadership.name: Sun Runming
leadership.title: Head of Seattle Division
leadership.notes: Portly, jovial, plays the oblivious hedonist to be constantly underestimated -- and pounces on any slip once he has been.

divisions.name: Wuxing North America
divisions.description: Wuxing North America manages the corporation's growing Seattle presence.
divisions.notes: Gao Kien leads the division.

organizations.notes:
The Skytower's growing chi is disrupting Lung's and Ryumyo's plans for the Asian dragon lines, warping magic across Hong Kong into mana surges and wild magic, and possibly (Hestaby suspects) feeding the natural disasters that struck Japan. The penthouse is laid out as a temple; the tower is warded, patrolled by bound air elementals and surrounded by an astral shallow that makes every astral form permanently visible. Wuxing's rapid growth has left gaps in its security, and it keeps close relationships with the Triads. It has Sea of Japan resource interests and joins regional maritime ventures and inspections.

In Seattle, Sun Runming heads the division -- portly and jovial, playing the oblivious hedonist so he is underestimated, then pouncing on any slip. Wuxing is setting up a new Seattle headquarters, using deniable runner teams played against one another to scout talent. The geomancer Sen Lo once turned down a permanent post with it.

[2060 – later developments] Lung-Wai wants Hualpa's bequest, the Elemental Scrolls of Ak'le'ar, badly enough to hire an outside Seattle team through the freelance fixer Denise Pierce while the scrolls sit at MIT&T. In Boston Wuxing works through the courier Huong and the Chinatown fixer Mr. Lee, and has brokered an unprecedented truce between the rival Triad houses, the Yellow Lotus and the Mutual Prosperity League, as its discreet local arm.
